jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

At Wise, we build and launch truly amazing products designed to give our customers smart & impactful solutions to their international money challenges. But creating ground-breaking products is only half the battle - we need everyone to know about them, understand them, and feel genuinely inspired to use them.

As a Senior Strategist, you will have strong creative judgement to help our target audience understand how Wise solves their international money problems. You will make sense of complex marketing & business problems, bringing together business priorities with customer & market insights to identify where creative can support business growth. You will write excellent, focused & inspiring creative briefs, and work closely with creative teams to deliver campaigns spanning channels such as Paid Social, Paid Display, Audio and more from idea to final execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

Bring clarity to complex marketing problems: Work with product, marketing and regional teams to unpack broad or ambiguous challenges. Ask the right questions, connect the available evidence and establish priorities, defining the problem we need to solve and the role creative can play.
Find the insight that unlocks the creative: Bring together customer research, market context and performance learnings to identify the motivations, tensions and barriers our communications need to address. Turn these into a clear strategic direction and the change we want to make.
Write creative briefs that inspire great work: Translate customer & market insights, and creative performance insights into focused, compelling creative briefs with clear objectives, audience insight and proposition. Giving creative teams a clear & inspiring starting point from which to develop bold, distinctive ideas.
Raise the quality of the work through creative critique: Assess creative concepts and executions against creative briefs - ensuring alignment to insights, and market priorities. Articulate what’s working, what isn’t and why, giving specific, constructive feedback that improves the work while preserving the strength of the idea.
Reinvent & own customer comms: Lead the strategic direction and storytelling of our quarterly "Mission Update" customer comms - turning company & product updates from functional comms into bold, engaging & memorable moments for our customers.
Connect data to creative impact: Interpret channel performance data across media channels into clear creative recommendations on what to test, refine, or scale, ensuring every creative asset drives measurable results.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

A proven track record in creative strategy, alongside broader marketing experience. You understand how customer needs, product messaging, media placement and commercial objectives come together, and can apply that to defined creative projects.
A knack for turning functional product messaging into fun, engaging narratives that will get customers using our products.
Strong creative judgement and an excellent ability to critique work. You can explain why an idea or execution will connect with its audience and deliver on the brief, identify where it falls short, and give actionable feedback grounded in strategy.
Comfortable interpreting channel performance metrics (i.e. CTR / CPA / conversion ... etc) to understand which creative narratives resonate best, and iterating for maximum impact.
Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to unite product, creative, and performance media teams around bold creative ideas.
A self-starter attitude - comfortable identifying comms gaps & pushing initiatives through to completion
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll be part of a team of exceptionally talented marketers who consistently break new ground in the way they engage customers.

Within Wise we operate in a flat structure, you’ll be in charge of your own workload and focus areas, giving you the chance to have a huge impact in one of the UK’s fastest growing & most successful startups.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: AI Workflow Specialist (On-site in Dubai)
jobs.description:
Turn AI into everyday operational impact for a $1Billion+ e-commerce brand. Build and run workflows that eliminate repetitive work, connect teams and systems, and deliver faster, more reliable results.

Up to AED 264,000 (tax-free) total annual cash compensation

(Base salary up to AED 20,000/month, plus a monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

Location
: Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support

Growth path
from here is Senior AI Workflow Specialist → AI Workflow Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023
: You'll personally map business processes, build and test AI-powered automations, and monitor and refine them in daily use. You remain accountable for output accuracy, reliable execution, exception handling, and measurable improvements in quality and turnaround time.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Workflow Specialist to own hands-on workflow delivery across process mapping, AI production, systems integration and team adoption, reporting directly to Mars Bai, Chief AI Operations Officer.

This role exists to turn business needs into reliable AI-enabled work, building reusable workflows and operating guides that help teams deliver accurate results without constant technical support.

The Problems You'll Own

Primary: Less effort, dependable results: The challenge is turning business requests into AI-enabled work that produces useful results consistently. Less manual effort is only a gain if quality holds when real inputs and exceptions arrive. The problem you own is making that improvement repeatable, with clear inputs, reliable outputs and checks that protect quality.
Secondary: Workflows that outlast the handoff: A solution has limited value if its users depend on its creator to keep it running. The supporting challenge is making workflows understandable, maintainable and usable by the teams they serve, without constant technical support.

The Career Accelerator

This is not a role where you collect prompts, run isolated demos or pass unchecked AI output to another team. You'll work across business functions, personally build and test workflows, and take evidence and decisions directly to the Chief AI Operations Officer.

Your first 12 months:
turn agreed business priorities into usable workflows, reusable components, reliable connections and operating guides. Shape how teams at Puffy use AI to improve work quality and reduce total human effort.
Map the work. Establish the required outcome, inputs, decisions, handoffs and current quality and human-effort baseline. Use AI to draft workflow specifications, then validate them with the people doing the work.
Build and test. Personally produce AI instructions, workflow configurations and reusable components. Test real inputs and exceptions, check accuracy and usefulness, and refine the workflow before deployment.
Connect systems reliably. Configure information flows between business tools and AI. Validate mappings and outputs, handle permissions carefully and retain appropriate human review before consequential actions.
Improve performance. Evaluate output quality, total human effort, elapsed turnaround, model and tool costs, reliability and maintenance needs. Use evidence to simplify work and correct failure patterns.
Enable adoption. Use AI to produce clear operating instructions, guides and knowledge resources, then verify them with users. Train teams, support troubleshooting and maintain reusable solutions.

Deliver usable workflows and checked outputs, not demonstrations alone. Good work is accurate, useful on real inputs, repeatable, understandable to its users and maintained after handoff.

Contribute early and work with fast turnaround on agreed priorities, without bypassing checks. Make quality, review effort, rework and handoff effort visible; measure elapsed turnaround separately. Own defects and improvements through resolution rather than passing an unverified AI output to the next team.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another workflow automation role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Workflow From Business Need to Daily Use

You build the workflow, validate the output and own the result.

You'll connect business requirements, AI production and team adoption in one hands-on role. Working directly with Mars, you'll use evidence on quality, effort and reliability to guide improvements, with appropriate human review before consequential actions.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Join an AI-first organization led by a Forbes Council Member CEO
Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Person Who Knows When a Workflow Is Ready

In most companies, automation work ends with a demo. Here, you're the person who can explain whether a workflow is useful, repeatable and ready for real inputs. When teams consider changing how they work, your test evidence helps them decide what to trust and where human review belongs. You'll build judgment about AI output quality and the communication skills to make that judgment usable. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a queue of manual fixes in front of you.

What You'll Need

Relevant experience. 2–3 years of experience in workflow automation, process optimization, operations or similar work involving systematic problem-solving. Logical reasoning and proven delivery matter more than job titles.
Hands-on AI delivery. Experience designing and delivering multi-step workflows using AI tools and workflow platforms, including practical application to business work.
Sound judgment and validation. Ability to translate a business problem into a clear workflow, test real inputs and judge whether the output is accurate, useful and repeatable. Strong logical reasoning is essential; coding experience is not required.
Curiosity and communication. Curiosity about AI, judgment about where new capabilities are useful, and clear communication and documentation skills for training and supporting business teams.
Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

Good-to-Have

Experience using workflow automation platforms, such as n8n, to connect applications and automate multi-step processes
Experience diagnosing issues in automated workflows; basic understanding of APIs and webhooks; ability to explain workflows with simple diagrams or flowcharts.

Resources Provided

You’ll have access to our latest company-provided AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, multiple AI agents, bots, plugins, AI projects, and automations through platforms such as n8n. You’ll also receive the department tools, relevant data, assets and specialist support needed to deliver your work. We expect you to use these resources to automate routine work and deliver high-quality results quickly.

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits

💰 Compensation:

Up to AED 264,000 (tax-free) total annual cash compensation (base + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
Annual salary review every January
Tax-free income
Annual return flight allowance to your home country
Parking allowance (up to AED 7,800 annually)

Life insurance & Personal Accident Insurance (24x monthly salary)

International team collaboration, 16+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

jobs.title: AI Video Editor & Creative Content Producer
jobs.description:
**Company:** PurpleBox  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Job Type:** Part-time

**About the Role**

PurpleBox is looking for a highly creative **AI Video Editor & Content Producer** who understands both traditional video production and the new generation of AI-powered creative tools.

We are **not looking for a basic video editor** who only cuts footage, adds music, captions and transitions.

We want someone who can take an idea or story and turn it into highly engaging, visually impressive social media content by combining:

* Real actors and actresses
* Real footage filmed at our locations
* AI-generated scenes
* AI-generated images and video
* Visual effects
* Creative transitions
* Sound design
* Motion graphics
* Strong storytelling

Our objective is to produce social media advertisements and organic content that make people stop scrolling, watch, engage and remember the PurpleBox brand.

**AI Experience Is Important**

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with **Higgsfield** and/or other leading AI creative platforms.

Experience with tools and models such as the following is highly valued:

* Higgsfield
* Kling
* Veo
* Sora
* Runway
* Midjourney
* Nano Banana / Gemini image tools
* Adobe Firefly
* Other emerging AI image and video generation tools

You should actively follow developments in AI video production and be interested in experimenting with new tools as they become available.

**What You Will Create**

You will work with our marketing team, actors and content creators to produce:

* Instagram Reels
* TikTok-style short-form videos
* Meta advertisements
* YouTube Shorts
* Brand films
* Promotional videos
* Story-driven advertisements
* Cinematic social media content
* Product and service advertisements

The content will primarily promote **PurpleBox Storage and PurpleBox Moving**.

**Your Responsibilities**

You will be responsible for taking content from **concept to final video**.

This includes developing creative concepts and storylines, reviewing scripts, planning shots, editing real footage, creating AI-generated scenes and assets, integrating AI footage naturally with live-action footage, adding motion graphics and visual effects, performing color grading and sound design, and delivering finished content optimized for social media.

You should also be able to look at ordinary footage and think:

**“How can I turn this into something people actually want to watch?”**

We want someone who can transform a simple idea into a story.

For example, instead of producing a standard video showing movers packing boxes, you should be able to build a story around the customer, the problem they are experiencing, the moving process, and the final result—using real footage where appropriate and AI-generated scenes where they improve the story.

**What We’re Looking For**

The successful candidate should have:

* Strong professional video-editing skills
* Excellent understanding of pacing, hooks and short-form storytelling
* Strong experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional editing software
* Practical experience using AI video and image-generation tools
* Ability to create consistent characters, environments and visual styles using AI
* Understanding of prompting and AI creative workflows
* Strong sense of cinematography, composition, lighting and camera movement
* Ability to integrate AI-generated footage with real footage convincingly
* Strong sound-design and music-selection skills
* Understanding of social media advertising and attention retention
* Ability to work quickly and produce multiple creative variations
* Strong creative judgment and attention to detail

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

jobs.title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a sharp, highly curious UA Creative Strategist to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.

This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.

You will sit at the intersection of creative, user acquisition, games and data.

We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

“What should we test next?”

You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.

What You’ll Do

Own Our UA Creative Direction

  • Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
  • Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
  • Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
  • Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.

Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities

  • Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
  • Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
  • Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
  • Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
  • Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.

Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make

  • Write clear, production-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
  • Explain not just what to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
  • Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
  • Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
  • Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.

Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine

  • Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
  • Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
  • Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
  • Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
  • Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.

Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently

  • Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
  • Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
  • Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
  • Experiment with AI-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
  • Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

About Us

We are an established Dubai-based retail group operating two growing brands: Sand Dollar Dubai
, a premium multi-brand fashion and resortwear retailer , and Heart Cottage Lane
, a homeware and lifestyle destination.

With multiple retail locations, established e-commerce platforms and ambitious growth plans, we are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Senior Performance Marketing Manager
to take full ownership of our paid digital advertising.

We currently work with an external advertising agency but are looking to bring this expertise in-house as our advertising investment and business continue to grow.

The Role

This is a hands-on, senior position for someone with extensive experience managing substantial Meta advertising budgets and delivering measurable, profitable results.

You will be responsible for developing, executing, monitoring and continuously optimising our paid advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram, targeting both domestic and international markets.

We are not looking for someone who simply boosts posts or follows standard advertising templates. We want a strategic thinker who understands customer behaviour, knows how to scale campaigns profitably and can identify opportunities to improve performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Meta Advertising & Campaign Management

- Take full ownership of Meta advertising across Facebook and Instagram.
- Demonstrate expert knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager/Business Suite, Events Manager and Commerce Manager.
- Plan, launch, manage and optimise campaigns across multiple brands and markets.
- Develop sophisticated audience targeting, retargeting, prospecting and customer acquisition strategies.
- Manage regional campaigns across the UAE, GCC and international markets.
- Allocate budgets strategically to maximise profitability and return on advertising spend.
- Recommend and test different campaign objectives, structures, placements and advertising formats.
- Manage Meta Pixel, Conversions API, catalogue advertising and product feeds.
- Stay ahead of Meta algorithm changes, platform developments and advertising best practices.

Analytics, Reporting & Performance

- Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), including e-commerce tracking, attribution and conversion analysis.
- Analyse Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Shopify data to understand advertising performance.
- Track ROAS, cost per acquisition, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates and overall campaign profitability.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and take proactive steps to improve results.
- Provide clear weekly and monthly reports with actionable recommendations.
- Understand attribution differences between Meta, Google Analytics and Shopify.
- Identify opportunities to increase customer lifetime value and maximise return from advertising investment.

Strategy & Business Growth

- Develop comprehensive advertising strategies for both brands.
- Recommend the most effective campaign types for product launches, new collections, seasonal promotions, clearance campaigns and customer acquisition.
- Build effective advertising funnels covering new customer acquisition, retargeting and repeat purchases.
- Recommend market expansion opportunities based on campaign data and performance.
- Work closely with our marketing and content teams to develop high-converting advertising creatives.
- Conduct structured A/B testing of creatives, audiences, messaging and landing pages.
- Advise management on advertising budgets, opportunities and growth strategies.
- Continuously identify new methods of improving online revenue and advertising efficiency.

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience
in Meta performance advertising, ideally within fashion, retail or e-commerce.
- Proven experience independently managing substantial monthly advertising budgets.
- Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.
- Advanced working knowledge of Google Analytics 4.
- Strong understanding of Shopify e-commerce tracking, conversion funnels and attribution.
- Demonstrable success managing profitable regional and international campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to make commercial decisions.
- Experience with dynamic product ads, catalogue campaigns, retargeting and audience segmentation.
- Confidence presenting performance results, strategies and recommendations directly to business owners.
- Ability to work independently and take full accountability for results.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is genuinely passionate about performance marketing and understands that successful advertising is measured by profitable sales, not simply clicks, impressions or engagement.

You must be proactive, analytical, commercially minded and confident enough to challenge existing strategies and recommend better approaches.

This is not a social media content creation or community management position. It is a specialist, performance-focused advertising role.

What We Offer

- Full-time, in-house position based in Dubai.
- Opportunity to manage advertising for two established retail brands.
- Direct involvement in strategic business and marketing decisions.
- Significant scope to develop, test and scale campaigns.
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience and proven results.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with:

1. Details of the advertising budgets you have personally managed.
2. Examples of successful Meta advertising campaigns, including ROAS and performance improvements.
3. Your experience advertising across UAE, GCC and international markets.
4. Your level of experience with GA4, Shopify and Meta advertising platforms.

Company Description

Welkom bij Publicis, een koploper op het gebied van reclame-, media- en communicatieadvies. Met bijna 500 medewerkers met ruim 40 verschillende nationaliteiten, omarmen we de rijke diversiteit aan kennis en achtergronden. Van commerce, data, media, creatie, PR tot en met productie - you name it, we've got it. Met deze diverse specialisaties bieden we onze klanten toegang tot kennis, data en tools. Met als doel: het creëren van persoonlijke ervaringen en inspiratie.

In 2021 hebben we onze krachten gebundeld met Boomerang Agency, waarmee we onze creatieve en social content expertises hebben versterkt.

Overview

Als Strategist
help je bij het vormgeven van merk-, creatieve en communicatiestrategieën die betekenisvolle verbindingen creëren tussen merken en mensen. Je vertaalt inzichten, signaleert kansen en zet zakelijke uitdagingen om in inspirerende strategische richtingen die de basis vormen voor impactvol creatief werk over verschillende kanalen heen.

Je werkt nauw samen met creatieve teams, account leads, producers en klanten aan geïntegreerde campagnes op het gebied van merk, digitaal, social, content en earned media. Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar cultuur en consumentengedrag, maar hebt ook een passie voor sterke ideeën, merkbouw en de rol die creativiteit speelt bij het oplossen van zakelijke uitdagingen.

Responsibilities

Strategieontwikkeling & Planning

Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling van merk-, communicatie- en creatieve strategieën voor lokale en internationale klanten.
Uitvoeren van doelgroep-, markt-, categorie- en cultuuronderzoek om relevante inzichten te ontdekken.
Vertalen van bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar heldere strategische aanbevelingen en communicatie-aanpakken.
Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van campagneplatforms, messaging frameworks en merkverhalen.
Meewerken aan geïntegreerde communicatieplannen over paid, owned, earned, digitale, sociale en traditionele kanalen.

Creatieve Strategie & Briefing

Ontwikkelen van inspirerende, inzichtgedreven creatieve briefs die teams helpen sterke campagne-ideeën te creëren.
Intensief samenwerken met creatieve teams gedurende het ontwikkel- en ideatieproces.
Ervoor zorgen dat strategisch denken centraal blijft staan tijdens het creatieve proces.
Kansen identificeren voor merken om relevant te zijn door middel van cultuur, consumenteninzichten en creativiteit.
Concepten en creatief werk beoordelen op basis van strategische doelstellingen en campagnedoelen.

Onderzoek, Consumenteninzichten & Culturele Intelligentie

Monitoren van consumentengedrag, categorieontwikkelingen, culturele verschuivingen en opkomende kansen.
Analyseren van onderzoek, campagneprestaties, doelgroepdata en marktinzichten.
Complexe informatie vertalen naar bruikbare strategische aanbevelingen.
Ondersteunen van workshops, stakeholderinterviews en insight-generatie sessies.

Cross-functionele Samenwerking

Nauw samenwerken met creatieve, accountmanagement-, productie-, media- en datateams.
Deelnemen aan klantworkshops, presentaties en strategische discussies.
Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen van strategische verhalen en klantpresentaties.
Helpen om bedrijfsdoelstellingen, strategisch denken en creatieve oplossingen gedurende projecten op één lijn te houden.

Qualifications

Je bent native Dutch speaker en communiceert vloeiend in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in strategie, planning, brand strategy, communications planning of creative strategy binnen een creatief, advertising, digitaal of geïntegreerd bureau.
Ervaring met geïntegreerde campagnes die verder gaan dan alleen social media.
Kennis van merkbouw, consumentengedrag, communicatieplanning en creatieve ontwikkeling.
Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van inzichten, strategische frameworks en creatieve briefs.
Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding in Marketing, Communicatie, Bedrijfskunde, Psychologie, Mediastudies of een vergelijkbare richting is een pré.

Wat jij meebrengt

Sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen.
Passie voor creativiteit en de impact van sterke ideeën op bedrijfsresultaten.
Nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, cultuur, merken en consumentengedrag.
Het vermogen om inzichten te ontdekken en deze te vertalen naar krachtige strategische richtingen.
Uitstekende storytelling- en presentatievaardigheden.
Zelfvertrouwen om samen te werken met zowel creatieve teams als klantenteams.
Sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te managen.
Interesse in geïntegreerde communicatie, merkstrategie en moderne marketing.

Additional Information

Wat bieden wij?

Een competitief salaris, een laptop en reiskostenvergoeding.
Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, inclusief toegang tot trainingen, cursussen en workshops.
De kans om te werken voor toonaangevende merken, samen met een ervaren internationaal bureau, binnen uiteenlopende sectoren.
Een gloednieuw en inspirerend kantoor in het Staal-Kade-gebouw in Amsterdam Zuid (opening in december 2026), met een fijne en informele werksfeer.
Het Work Your World Programma: de mogelijkheid om tot zes weken per jaar vanuit een andere locatie in de wereld te werken.
Korting op ClassPass en deelname aan een fietsplan.
Een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gehoord, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

je dient te beschikken over een geldige werkvergunning of verblijfsvergunning om in Nederland te mogen werken.

Was zu tun ist.

Die besten geheimen Locations für Partys? Da sollte man dich fragen. Wenn das Ordnungsamt kommt, wundert sich jeder, dass du eine Genehmigung hast und am nächsten Tag steht schon der Aftermovie? Du arbeitest eng mit der Videoproduktion und unseren Social Media Manager:innen und anderen Kreativköpfen zusammen.

Sobre MITO
MITO es una plataforma colaborativa y nativa en IA que está reinventando cómo se hacen películas, anuncios y videoclips. Trabajamos entre San Francisco y Madrid y combinamos los mejores modelos de imagen, vídeo y audio con herramientas profesionales de edición agéntica, en un canvas multijugador en el navegador.
MITO Films es nuestro estudio. Aquí producimos piezas reales para marcas, agencias y productoras usando nuestra propia tecnología, y aquí se demuestra lo que la IA puede hacer cuando la dirige gente que sabe contar historias.
Nos fundaron Iñaki Berenguer (MIT, PhD Cambridge, 5 veces fundador: Pixable, CoverWallet, iPronics), Danny Saltaren (diseñador de producto en dos unicornios, Premio Nacional de Diseño) y Arantxa Barcia (cineasta premiada). Nos respaldan Lightspeed, Bessemer, Kibo Ventures, K Fund, scouts de Sequoia y a16z, y fundadores de cinco unicornios.
El rol
Buscamos un perfil senior que lleve proyectos audiovisuales de principio a fin: desde el brief del cliente hasta la entrega final. Serás la persona que convierte una idea en una pieza terminada, que coordina a artistas y editores, y que sabe meterse en la herramienta cuando hace falta. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Produktion KI-generierter Videos, belegt durch ein Portfolio mit Arbeiten auf Basis aktueller Video-, Avatar- und Voice-Lösungen (kommerziell und Open Source).

Prompt-Engineering für Bild- und Videomodelle, LoRA-Training oder Character-Consistency-Techniken

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech brands, from research and media platforms to membership and card products. We are looking for an Art Director to give them a visual identity that feels deliberate, consistent and credible.
The situation

Dozens of our websites and platforms were built at different times, by different people, mostly on Wix, custom HTML and application frameworks. Many began as temporary solutions and stayed. Later products and branches inherited the look of the one before, so the inconsistencies compounded. Nobody has owned the visual system across the portfolio. You will.
The role

You will set the visual direction across several projects at once. Your first project is the Longevity Club and Card pilot, which means a bounded visual and messaging kit and one approved journey. After that, other products come through our request intake, one at a time. You will have real authority to audit legacy design, decide what stays, and rebuild it properly.
You work AI-first: you find references, brief AI tools and freelancers, review the options, then choose, merge and approve the final result. You are accountable for what ships. Taste and judgement are the job, not hands-on production.
What you will do

Audit current visuals and propose an order for fixing them
Define the visual system, guidelines and templates for each product
Direct AI image, page and video production, and approve the final result
Brief, manage and review freelancers and agencies
Approve the look of websites, product UI and video together with Product and Front-end
Report on requests, decisions and progress in writing, regularly

What the environment is like

We are a research organisation, so the look we want is serious, clear and trustworthy, closer to a credible institution than a wellness brand. The work runs through a structured intake and review process, with regular written reporting. If you like clear priorities and see structure as a way to get good work shipped, you will fit in well.
The MarTech team is growing, and the roles around you (product, front-end, marketing operations) are still being filled, so you would help shape how design works here. The team moves fast and has no technical limits on tooling.
What we are looking for

A strong portfolio and demonstrable taste: you can explain why something works and what to change
Agency or studio experience handling several brands or clients at once
Experience bringing order to an inconsistent or inherited brand or product line
Fluency with current AI image, design and video tools, and clear brief-writing for them
Experience commissioning and reviewing work from freelancers or agencies
Resourcefulness: you find a way, and you bring initiative into the process
Comfort with written reporting and a structured review process
Nice to have: video or AI-video direction, Figma and design-system experience, experience in science, health or finance, fluent in Russian

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio en forte croissance, opérant plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement à l'international. Notre acquisition payante repose aujourd'hui largement sur Google, et notre diversification passe par Meta et TikTok. Sur ces canaux, le facteur limitant n'est pas le ciblage : c'est le débit et la qualité créative.

Aujourd'hui, le montage est assuré en interne par une seule personne, les media buyers briefent au fil de l'eau, et personne ne possède la stratégie créative ni le vivier de production. Résultat : une matrice d'angles limitée, pas de cadence tenue, pas de boucle d'apprentissage entre la performance d'une créa et le concept suivant. Et surtout, aucun liant avec les studios créatifs et les acteurs UGC.

C'est pour ça que nous créons le poste de Creative Strategist. Tu deviens le point de convergence entre nos media buyers (Google, Meta, TikTok), notre montage interne, et un écosystème de production externe que tu construis toi-même.

Ta mission : posséder la chaîne créative de bout en bout, sur l'ensemble du portefeuille et sur tous les marchés - recherche audience, angles, briefs, production, mise en ligne, analyse, itération. Livrer un flux constant, prévisible et mesuré de créas qui font baisser le CPA, dans plusieurs langues et plusieurs cultures.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoindras l'équipe Growth & Acquisition, pilotée par Bastien BRICOUT, notre Chief Growth Officer, qui sera ton manager direct. Tu travailleras au quotidien avec nos media buyers Google, Meta et TikTok - dont Caroline AUDEBERT, notre Experte SEA - ainsi qu'avec notre monteur interne. L'équipe est full remote, orientée performance, avec une culture de l'autonomie et du résultat.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Stratégie créative et personas

  • Recherche audience structurée par marché : reviews produit, tickets support, verbatims, communautés locales, commentaires ads, retours des media buyers

  • Construction et maintien des personas par produit et par marché - un persona US n'est pas un persona FR traduit

  • Matrice d'angles par produit, par marché et par niveau de conscience

  • Veille concurrentielle internationale : Ad Library sur plusieurs pays, formats émergents, patterns qui montent sur un marché avant d'arriver sur les autres

  • Priorisation des hypothèses créatives à tester

Pilotage du vivier de production

  • Sourcing et casting de créateur(rice)s et acteur(rice)s UGC sur toutes les langues ciblées - le vivier est à construire, il n'existe pas encore

  • Briefs adaptés à la culture locale : script, ton, cadrage, décor, obligations et interdits

  • Briefs de niveau exécution pour le montage interne : structure, timing des cuts, hooks visuels, sous-titres, B-roll, specs par plateforme

  • Arbitrage permanent entre montage interne, UGC et studio, selon coût, délai, langue et enjeu

Pilotage opérationnel et budget

jobs.description:
Job Description: Creative Strategist

Role summary

YAMU Media is hiring a Creative Strategist to own the creative side of paid media for a pod of 5 to 8 clients. You decide what gets made, write and direct it, and use what the ads do in market to decide what gets made next.

This is a hands-on role. You write the scripts (using AI to draft at volume, then editing by hand), find and brief the talent, give direction on raw footage, and guide the editors and designers. You also read the performance data yourself and set the priority list for new creative, so the work stays tied to results.

What you'll own

  • Write scripts. Turn the creative angle, customer research and past winners into hooks and full video scripts for each client. Write every hook, re-hook and call to action, and make each script easy for talent to deliver and easy for an editor to cut.
  • Source talent. Find, vet and book the creators and on-camera talent each client needs, and keep a bench of proven people so new concepts can start quickly.
  • Direct talent. Brief talent before the shoot, give clear direction on delivery and on-camera performance, and give specific notes on the takes you receive.
  • Direct raw footage. Review raw footage, choose the usable takes and moments, and tell editors which hooks, lines and sections to build the cut around.
  • Direct the creative team. Brief editors and designers with a clear goal, reference and success measure for each asset, and give written feedback that gets to a finished ad in as few rounds as possible.
  • Analyze creative performance. Read ad-level results for each client, work out why ads won or lost (hook, angle, format, talent, offer), and write down what to repeat, iterate or retire.
  • Set creative priorities. Decide what the team makes next for each client and in what order, balancing iterations on proven ads against new concepts, and keep that list current as results come in.

Using AI to write scripts at volume

You will use AI to draft far more scripts than one writer could produce by hand, and you will be the editor who decides what is good enough to shoot. AI is the first draft. You are the final say.

  • Draft in volume. Use AI to generate many hooks and script variations from the creative angle, customer research, offer and past winning ads.
  • Vary on purpose. Ask for different angles, hook types, formats and lengths, not many copies of one idea, so each batch gives the pod something real to test.
  • Edit every script by hand. Nothing goes to talent or the client without a human read. You cut, rewrite and sharpen each draft so it sounds like a real person talking, fits the brand and is easy to perform.
  • Check every claim. AI can invent facts, results and testimonials. You verify each claim, number and promise against the client's own materials, and you keep scripts within platform ad policy and any client or legal rules.
  • Build the system. Maintain the prompts, reference documents (research, personas, offer, past winners) and script templates your pod uses, and improve them based on which drafts get approved and which ads perform.
  • Close the loop. Label each script by angle and hook type, so performance data shows what to ask AI for next.
  • Know when not to use it. Some concepts, especially ones that depend on a personal story or a delicate topic, are better written by you from scratch.

Writing modular scripts

Every script you write is built from interchangeable sections, so one shoot can produce many ad variations and we can test one element at a time.

  • Write in blocks

And now, we’re looking for you!

The role holder plans and delivers 6PM's content productions and live brand formats,

and manages the external partners required for both. Concept and visual language are

owned by Brand. This role is accountable for feasibility, cost, resourcing, scheduling,

compliance and delivery.

The role exists to consolidate two production disciplines under one owner, from

standalone campaign shoots to brand experiences and pop-ups.

Tasks

Content production (approx. 40%)

Translate creative concepts from Brand into production plans, schedules and budgets.

Book and manage crew, casting, talent, models, locations, studios and equipment in alignment with Brand and Marketing.

Run pre-production, production and post-production through edit, grade, retouch and delivery in the required channel formats.

Manage usage rights, buyouts, model releases and music licensing, and maintain the record of what has been licensed for how long.

Live formats (approx. 40%)

Plan and deliver pop-ups, drop events, PR stunts, community and music formats.

Secure locations and contracts; obtain permits and manage official conditions with the relevant authorities.

Select, contract and manage suppliers across set build, technical production, security, catering and logistics.

Prepare risk assessments and implement safety concepts, including capacity limits, queue management, escape routes, stewarding and the emergency escalation chain.

Manage run of show, talent and VIP handling, load-out and reinstatement.

Integration of content and live (approx. 10%)

Plan content capture into every live format at concept stage, including shot list, camera positions and lighting.

Coordinate capture crew and same-day or next-day asset delivery with Social and Brand.

Operations and partner management (approx. 10%)

Maintain the production calendar with milestones, lead times and points of no return, and feed it into the marketing calendar.

Build and maintain the freelancer and supplier bench, including rate cards and framework agreements.

Control production budgets, track committed versus actual spend, and report variances to the Head of Marketing.

Conduct a written debrief after each production covering cost, timing and learnings, and update standard lead times accordingly.

Weightings are indicative and shift with the seasonal calendar.

Requirements

Essential

4 to 6 years in production, with demonstrable work on both content productions and live formats.

Background in fashion, streetwear, music, entertainment or sport.

Independent budget responsibility: builds production budgets, tracks them and delivers close to plan.

Established supplier and freelancer network in DACH across both content and live.

Manages risk assessments and implements safety concepts: capacity, queue management, escape routes, stewarding, escalation chain.

Working knowledge of permit processes with German municipal authorities, including realistic processing times.

Experience with talent, artists, agencies and VIPs, including riders, advancing and usage rights.

Understanding of streetwear, fashion and music, and of the 6PM community.

Willingness to escalate and to stop a format on safety or feasibility grounds.

German fluent, English confident.

Preferred

Drops and queue management, store openings or retail, festival or club production.

Post-production supervision.

Agency production background.

Productions outside DACH.

Vocational qualification in event management (Veranstaltungskaufmann/-frau, Veranstaltungsfachwirt IHK) or equivalent production training.

Formal education is not a selection criterion. Assessment is based on delivered

productions.

Modern office in Berlin, complimentary drinks & work-from-home Fridays

Contribution towards a gym membership as well as various mobility benefits

Individual training and development opportunities to support your professional and personal growth

Regular team events and incentives

Flexible working hours based on trust within a young, motivated team

Attractive salary package with a variable compensation component

We're looking for a brilliant Design Leader to take on the next chapter of Treatwell's creative and brand design across Europe.

We're entering an exciting new phase, filled with fresh energy, bold ideas and ambitious plans for the next generation of the Treatwell brand and the industry around it.

We've built an in-house Creative Studio to match that ambition, and now we're looking for a Creative Design Lead to help take its work to the next level.

Requirements

The role

Sitting with the Global brand team, you'll be the most senior designer within our in-house Creative Studio. You'll lead the design team, set the visual standard and remain deeply hands-on in creating the work.

This isn't a traditional Design Lead role where you'll direct from a distance. You'll be a practising designer who loves developing concepts, getting into the detail and turning ideas into beautifully crafted, effective creative.

Working across 13 European markets, you'll lead design for major brand campaigns, product launches, paid and organic social, CRM, content and digital experiences. You'll balance strong creative instincts with commercial thinking, ensuring our work is distinctive, relevant and built to perform.

You'll help us evolve how Treatwell shows up in the world, while developing a talented team and creating the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

You Will Be Responsible For

Leading design across the brand: Setting the creative and visual direction across integrated campaigns, launches, content, paid media, CRM, internal communications and other key brand touchpoints.
Creating exceptional work: Personally concepting, designing and delivering high-priority creative alongside the team. You'll remain close to the tools, the craft and the detail from the first idea through to final execution.
Leading and developing the design team: Managing, mentoring and upskilling designers and motion designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback that raises the quality of the team's work.
Owning our biggest creative briefs: Leading major campaigns and cross-functional projects from concept to delivery, including work across TV, OOH, digital and social.
Setting and protecting the design standard: Ensuring every piece of work feels distinctive, cohesive and unmistakably Treatwell, while continuing to evolve our visual identity and design systems.
Connecting creativity with performance: Understanding when exceptional craft will build the brand and when platform-native creative will drive attention, engagement and action.
Designing for digital channels: Creating and guiding work across paid social, organic social, CRM, web and other digital formats, with a strong understanding of how design needs to flex across platforms and objectives.
Connecting product and brand: Working closely with Product and Marketing to build a stronger visual connection between the Treatwell brand, app and wider customer experience.
Collaborating across the business: Partnering with Brand, Marketing, Product, Performance and local market teams to turn strategic and commercial objectives into compelling creative work.
Improving how the studio works: Helping the team prioritise effectively, give and receive better feedback, use new tools intelligently and deliver high-quality work at pace.

About You

You have 7+ years of experience in senior design roles, with experience leading or managing designers in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
You're an exceptional, hands-on designer with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual thinking, original ideas and beautifully crafted execution.
You have significant experience developing and delivering integrated brand campaigns across channels such as TV, OOH, digital, social and CRM.
You're confident taking a project from an early strategic brief through concept development, design and final delivery.
You've successfully led and developed in-house designers, raising both individual capability and the overall standard of creative output.
You're just as comfortable designing the work yourself as you are setting direction, presenting ideas and giving clear feedback to others.
You understand how to build a distinctive brand while creating digital and performance-led work that delivers against commercial goals.
You can bring clarity, structure and calm to a busy studio without compromising ambition or creative quality.
You're confident collaborating with senior stakeholders and explaining the thinking behind your creative decisions.
You're curious about new technology and how AI and emerging tools can improve creative development and production without compromising craft.

Portfolio Required

We want to see big ideas, sharp visual thinking and beautifully crafted design work.

Show us campaigns you've led and personally contributed to, digital creative you've developed and work that made a tangible impact. We're interested in how you think, how you design, how you lead others and how you bring a brand to life across different channels.

Please make your own contribution to each project clear. We want to understand the role you played across strategy, concept, design and execution.

Benefits

Hi, we're Treatwell. Nice to meet you.

We're a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We're the industry's smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe's leading bookings platform, working with over 50,000 salon partners across 17 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And....breathe.

But we're not done yet. We're on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.

If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.

Benefits platform offering cycle to work scheme, high street discounts and other perks

A dynamic organisation with Thursday drinks in the office

jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
TL;DR
- We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What You'll Do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)
Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it
Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time
Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets
Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What We're Looking For

Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software
Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself
Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems
Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste
Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on
You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools
Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling
Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Our tech stack

Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:

Frontend: React, Tailwind
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers
DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next, especially in image/video generation APIs and pipelines. You’ll build custom tools in chorus with Lovable, while also contributing to Lovable upstream.

How We Hire

Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
Show us some of your work you're really proud of.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
In some cases, we may opt to do paid trial work.

About Your Application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We are prioritizing candidates who are based in London or Stockholm, or those willing to relocate.
We treat all candidates equally and if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™
and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Senior Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.
Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.
Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.
Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.
Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.
Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.
Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.
Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.
Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.
Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.
Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.
Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.
Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).
Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What we offer

Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.
