About Us

At Walls Nation, we believe great design belongs in every space. Through our own facilities and a trusted manufacturing network spanning the region, we bring iconic designer furniture to life, crafted to exacting standards. Our pieces have shaped homes, hotels and retail spaces across MENA. We pair thoughtful craftsmanship with rigorous quality control and smart automation, creating seamless solutions for interior designers, holiday home operators and developers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Brand Strategist to be the keeper of how Walls Nation looks, feels and speaks. You'll define our visual and strategic identity, shape the guidelines that hold it together, and lead the design work that brings it to life across every screen, page and showroom. From a social post to a printed catalogue, everything that carries our name should feel unmistakably Walls Nation. You'll work hand in hand with our Content Creator and report directly to the CEO.

What You'll Do

• Shape a brand strategy rooted in our positioning and ambitions for the market

• Build and evolve our brand guidelines, covering logo, typography, colour, tone of voice and visual standards

• Design the pieces that tell our story, from social creatives and product catalogues to brochures and presentation decks, using Adobe Illustrator and related tools

• Keep the brand consistent wherever it appears, including our digital platforms, print, product photography and customer communications

• Partner with our Content Creator so every visual and every story speak the same language
• Lead creative direction for campaigns, from first idea to final artwork

• Curate our brand asset library so every team works with current, approved materials

• Act as the final creative eye, reviewing and approving work before it's published or printed

• Keep a close watch on how competitors present themselves, and bring fresh ideas to keep us ahead

• Help the CEO present brand direction and strategy updates

What You Bring

• A Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Marketing or a related field

• At least 3 years in brand management or graphic design, ideally in retail, e-commerce or furniture and interiors

• Expert command of Adobe Illustrator (essential); Photoshop and InDesign are a plus

• A portfolio of brand identity and graphic design work that shows your eye

• Fluency in both Arabic and English, spoken and written (essential)

• Current UAE residency

Why Walls Nation

Join a Dubai-born brand at the intersection of design, craft and technology, and help define how the region lives with beautiful things.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Wellness is your lifestyle. Now make it your job. You're the friend who flips the packet over before it goes in the basket. You know your seed oils from your cold-pressed, your protein bars from your candy bars in disguise, and you've probably filmed a "what I eat in a day" just for fun. If wellness isn't just your feed but your actual lifestyle, keep reading.

Who we are Generation H is the first clean-label verified online health food store in the MENA region
. Before any product lands on our shelves, we read every ingredient, check it against strict clean-label standards and only list what passes. No hidden sugars, no mystery additives, no fine-print surprises.
Our promise is simple: we read the labels, so you don't have to.

We curate the brands health-conscious people actually want, from global favourites to exclusive brands you won't find anywhere else in the region. Snacks, breakfast, pantry staples, baking, sauces, all filterable by gluten-free, keto, vegan, dairy-free and refined-sugar-free, delivered across the UAE.

But we're not just a store. We're building a movement: a generation that knows what's in its food and refuses to settle for less.

The role: Marketing Lead We're looking for a creative, hands-on Marketing Lead to own how Generation H shows up in the world, and to lead the clean-label movement in the region.
This isn't a "post three times a week and call it a day" job. You'll bring the ideas, spot the trends before they peak, film the content, build the community and turn good ideas into campaigns people actually talk about (and buy from). You'll be the face, the voice and the creative engine behind the brand, working directly with the founders.

What you'll be doing Create content people stop scrolling for

Come up with ideas and creative direction for Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels and vlogs, and get in front of the camera when the idea calls for it.
Turn label-reading into content: ingredient breakdowns, swaps, hauls, taste tests, "what's really in this" moments.
Work with our content creators and partners to keep the feed fresh, useful and on-brand.

Lead campaigns that move the needle

Plan and run campaigns around product launches, seasonal moments (hello, Ramadan and New Year resets), promotions and brand collabs.
Bring our exclusive brands to life with their own launch plans, creator collabs and content that makes them stand out.
Keep social, website, email, WhatsApp and paid campaigns working together as one story.

Build the community

Find and partner with creators and influencers who genuinely live the lifestyle, and run collaborations from first DM to final report.
Build partnerships with brands, nutritionists, gyms, schools, nurseries and wellness communities.
Take the brand offline too: pop-ups, events, activations and run-club or gym takeovers.

Stay ahead of the curve

Track trends, competitors and customer feedback, and turn what you learn into new ideas and better results.
Keep a commercial eye on everything: know what's working, what's selling and what to try next.

You'll love this role if you... Live the better-for-you lifestyle and get genuinely excited about clean ingredients, new brands and healthy swaps.
Love creating: filming, editing, vlogging, writing hooks and storytelling come naturally to you.
Are a connector who loves meeting people, building relationships and bringing communities together.
Have ideas constantly and actually follow through on them.
Are organised, take ownership and are happy to roll up your sleeves, whether that's a campaign plan or a quick shoot in the warehouse.
Think commercially: likes are great, but you care about what drives sales.

Experience that helps

Hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media, influencer marketing and campaign planning.
A content portfolio or your own channel we can check out is a big plus.

Why Generation H Lead a movement, not just a feed.
You'll help define what clean-label means for a whole region.
Real creative freedom.
Small team, big ideas, fast decisions. If you can pitch it, you can probably launch it.
Your work, front and centre.
Your content and campaigns go live and you'll see the impact on the business.
Grow with us.
We're early, ambitious and growing, and we want you to become our trusted right hand in marketing and grow alongside the brand.
First dibs on the good stuff.
You'll be the first to try new brands and products before they hit the site.

Ready to apply? Send us your CV plus your portfolio, at team@generationh.ae
.

To stand out, add one content or campaign idea you'd launch for Generation H in your first month.

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
CREATIVE PRODUCER

COMPANY : FLIGHTSTORY

REPORTING TO : HEAD OF CONTENT OPERATIONS

ABOUT FLIGHTSTORY

We’re a media and investment company, and our mission is to elevate the stories, build the communities and invest in visionary entrepreneurs contributing to a happier, healthier humanity

YOUR MISSION

To bring executional and creative excellence to everything FlightStory’s Central Production team works across, making sure every shoot, edit and IP moment is produced with precision and delivered to Flight’s editorial and technical standards.
You’ll work alongside creative & commercial teams to turn ideas into shoots that land, taking ownership through post-production to final delivery. You’re someone who makes things happen - self-sufficient, full of initiative and bringing a creative eye to everything we make.
While you’ll be the steady, skilled hand behind the Central Production team’s branded content output, you’ll be equally at home with longform production, editorial packaging or a social shoot. The driving force behind every project, your focus will be on getting the creative made, and made well.

DAY TO DAY

CREATIVE & COMMERCIAL PRODUCTION

Own the execution of commercial and branded productions from brief to delivery, making sure the creative idea survives contact with the shoot.
Work alongside creative teams and directors to turn briefs, scripts and storyboards into shoot plans that are both ambitious and achievable.
Act as a production check on what’s written, flagging early where an idea needs rethinking from a practical, editorial or technical point of view.
Be the producer on the ground on shoot days: keeping the day on track, working with talent, crew, and making the right calls when plans change.
Help set and protect the creative and technical standard across shoots, contributing craft that raises the bar for the wider team.

POST-PRODUCTION

Build and own post-production timelines for commercial projects in collaboration with delivery managers and creative editors, from rushes through to final delivery.
Work with editors, designers and motion teams to keep the edit moving, running feedback rounds and getting sign-off on time.
Manage feedback from internal stakeholders and brand partners with clarity, keeping versions and deliverables organised.
Spot risks to deadlines early and find a way through them without compromising quality.

EXECUTIONAL SUPPORT ACROSS LONGFORM SHOWS

Stay close to each longform show’s workflow, ready to provide production, technical or editorial support wherever a gap opens up.
Build fluency across IP and formats to support all of central production’s flagship shows without a long ramp-up, and to inform the creative & delivery of each show’s branded content output.
Creatively support on longform show packaging and act as a thinking and executional partner for the show’s producers.

CRAFT, CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & AI

Keep a pulse on industry and platform trends, formats and production techniques, and bring new thinking back to the team.
Stay curious about AI tools coming into production. Test what’s promising, be honest about what isn’t, and bring the useful ones into how we work.
Spot process gaps or inefficiencies across our production workflow and help build the fixes rather than just flagging them.
Contribute to the development of new shows and formats, bringing a producer’s eye to early-stage ideas.
Be a driver and advocate for continuous improvement across Central Production and encourage the team to follow suit.

COMPETENCIES

Hands-On Producer
- Comfortable producing editorially and technically across longform and commercial shoots, with the versatility to lead a shoot or run a studio session without hand-holding.
Creative Collaborator
- Turns a creative brief into a shoot that actually works, bringing scripting and production instinct to commercial output.
Self-Sufficient
- Works independently, owns projects end to end and doesn’t hesitate to get things done.
Data-Literate
- Comfortable digging into performance and spend data, and confident using it to make and defend decisions.
Organised
- Keeps timelines, feedback and deliverables tight across several projects at once.
Post-Production Savvy
- Understands how an edit comes together and can plan realistic timelines that protect quality.
Industry-Aware
- Keeps a pulse on platform trends, formats and production techniques and AI tools, and brings new thinking back to the team.
Clear Communicator
- Confident briefing hosts, guests and talent, and communicating clearly across creative, commercial and production stakeholders.
What Success Looks Like

Commercial productions are delivered on time, on brief and to a standard the creative team and brand partners are proud of
The creative team trust you as the person who gets their ideas made properly
Post-production runs to a clear timeline, without last-minute scrambles on delivery
Longform producers know they can lean on you and get the support they need, when they need it
Decisions on formats, packaging and resourcing are routinely backed by data you’ve brought to the table
You bring new ideas and techniques to the team and help raise the bar on how we make things

You'll Thrive Here If You

Think like a producer and a creative, and know how to get an idea from the page to the screen
Are equally comfortable on set and in the edit
Take ownership and enjoy making things happen without being asked
Stay calm and resourceful when a shoot or deadline doesn't go to plan
Care about craft, and see branded content as a chance to make something people actually want to watch

jobs.title: AI Lead
jobs.description:
Brand Aid Group is a marketing execution platform for the Middle East. We design, produce and deliver point-of-sale materials, in-store visibility, fit-outs, events, activations and exhibitions for the region's biggest consumer brands.

1,200 people. 9 markets across the Gulf, Egypt and the Levant. 11 production facilities. Over the last 18 months we rebuilt the company on one ERP, one structure and one way of running every market. The infrastructure is in place. Now we want to put AI to work inside it.

THE ROLE
You will be our first AI hire, reporting to the Group CEO. Your mandate: take the Studio, our costing and our client service to a different level using AI. Not a lab. Not a pilot deck. Working tools used every day by designers, estimators and account managers.
You get a tools budget, direct access to the CEO and the authority to change how things are done.

Location: Dubai or Cairo, with regular time in our other markets.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Studio: put AI into briefing, concepting, adaptation across markets and languages, and asset management. Give every country manager a live view of designer workload and utilisation.
• Costing: build estimation tools that learn from thousands of past jobs in our ERP, so a standard quote goes out in hours, not days, and margins stop surprising us.
• Client service: faster brief intake, automatic status updates and reporting, quicker answers to clients.
• Fix the data first: clean job, cost and pricing data in the ERP.
• Buy before build: pick, negotiate and integrate tools. Build only where nothing fits.
• Set the rules: client IP, data security, what goes into which model and what never does.
• Train people and measure adoption, not demos.
• Report results to the CEO monthly: hours saved, margin protected, turnaround cut.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
6 months: one tool live and in daily use in each of the three areas, clean job cost data in our two largest markets, and a written AI playbook.
12 months: quote turnaround cut from days to hours, Studio output up with the same headcount, client reporting automated for top accounts, and a roadmap for the next phase.

WHO YOU ARE
• 5+ years shipping software, automation or data products inside an operating business.
• 2+ years putting LLMs and AI tools into real workflows used daily by non-technical people.
• Hands-on with AI APIs and no-code/low-code tools, and able to connect them to an ERP. Odoo experience is a strong plus.
• Experience near creative production, marketing services, agencies or manufacturing.
• You explain things simply to a designer, an estimator and a CFO. English is a must, Arabic helps.
• Comfortable in a fast, multi-country business, and happy to spend time in Cairo, Riyadh and Erbil.
• You ship. Small, early, imperfect, then better.

NOT FOR YOU IF
You want to research models rather than put them to work, you need a big team before you can start, or you think the hard part is the technology. Here the hard part is 1,200 people changing how they work.

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and one page on something you automated that people still use today: what it was, who uses it, and what changed because of it. No cover letter.

About Us

At Cambridge Audio, we're a different sort of global audio company, resolutely independent and always authentic.
We're on a mission to break down barriers to top-tier sound, so it's not the exception, but the norm. It's what we've been doing for over 50 years, and we're only just getting started.

Our award-winning product lineup includes headphones, lifestyle audio, and premium hi-fi. We also own StreamMagic, our own music streaming platform, plus a music venue and bar called Melomania at our London Bridge HQ.

Work at Cambridge Audio is more than just a job. We're passionate about what we do, and have fun doing it, developing our skills and careers, plus those of the colleagues around us. Learn more at https://cambridgeaudio.com/about-us 

Our Culture

A shared love for music and a commitment to exceptional products and customer experience drive us. With strong team spirit across our five global offices, our core values define our work:

Made By Music -
Inspired by shared passion and independence.
Pride in our product and service -
Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.
Embrace the culture -
Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.
Make an impact -
See it through. Go the extra mile.

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional person to join Cambridge Audio at a crucial time. We launched our new identity last year and have released a run of category-defining products through 2026, earning awards, critical acclaim and design accolades along the way. We need a Head of Creative to set the creative standard for what comes next. You will be the creative authority for the brand, responsible for the quality, consistency and impact of everything we put into the world, from product film and photography to web, print and live events. You will work closely with the CMO and the Head of PR and lead a small in-house creative studio. The company is small, the goals are demanding and the pace is high.

Key Responsibilities

Set the creative vision:
Define and champion the creative direction across all channels (web, print, video, physical and digital), expressing our pillars: Inspired by music. Crafted by design. Shaped by culture.
Lead the function:
Own the creative team, workflow, budget and resourcing, blending in-house talent with agencies, copywriters and freelancers to deliver first-class work.
Lead the work from concept to delivery:
Art direct every shoot and campaign, owning the quality of the output and the results it delivers.
Own content direction:
Help shape and deliver a content strategy built around our brand pillars that reaches the right audiences, with a clear view of what success looks like.
Unite copy and design:
Direct tone of voice and copy alongside visual work. Own and evolve the brand guidelines and roll them out consistently across global markets.
Connect product and marketing:
Work with Engineering, Product and Marketing to shape creative requirements early in product development.
Be a voice of the brand:
Present the brand and creative direction to listeners, press, retailers and internal teams with confidence.
Build the process:
Put in place the planning, briefing and approval processes that let a small team deliver at pace without compromising standards.
Stay hands-on:
Pitch in and support design at busy times with the right skills and tools.

Requirements

Creative Director/Head of Creative experience leading creative teams and external partners, including remotely, delivering on time and on budget across the campaign lifecycle from concept to delivery.
A strong creative portfolio across multiple mediums and channels, including AV, Stills, Digital and ATL.
Agency or similar in-house studio experience is essential.
Passion for music, contemporary culture and technology.
Deep understanding of how brand contributes to business growth, helping Cambridge Audio reach new audiences, drive product relevance, and open up new opportunities.
Experience in hiring, nurturing and developing creative talent.
Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, or at least genuinely receptive and excited to experiment with AI design tools and integrate them into your workflow.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to represent the brand.
Strong planning and project management skills in a small, scaling business.

Desirable

Experience in technology and/or lifestyle businesses, Agency or publishing background
Experience repositioning or evolving a brand with heritage
Adobe Creative Suite proficiency and/or Web UX/UI experience.
Understanding of how brand and creative drive business growth, product relevance and new audiences

Personal Profile

Charismatic, personable and easy to work with.
Driven, with the conviction to guide change and the drive to keep the brand relevant and ahead of the curve.

Working Pattern & Duration

Location

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. Most creatives get handed a product and a deadline. Here, you get handed a lab pass.

We are looking for a Senior Creative to join the Dyson Creative Studio in London: an in-house department built to approach creativity in a way that does justice to our iconic products.

You’ll have the chance to sit next to the engineers and scientists inventing the technology, and the designers working on colours, materials and finishes. You will find the detail nobody else noticed and turn it into work the world remembers.

About The Studio

The Dyson Creative Studio is based at Pear Tree Court in Clerkenwell, London, and led by Pablo González de la Peña, Global Head of Creative. It works alongside Dyson's product creative teams in Malmesbury, home of our UK headquarters, and at our global headquarters in Singapore.

We are a creative resource for the whole company, not just marketing. Our work can influence product creation, portfolio strategy and the way Dyson explains its technology to the world. We start at the very beginning, in the lab, so creativity is baked in from day one rather than added at the end.

In its first year, the studio has brought to life Dyson CameraJet, our biggest launch of the last decade, alongside Dyson HushJet MiniCool and Dyson Supersonic Travel. And with the pipeline of new technology coming, there is a lot more to do.

About The Role

As a Senior Creative, you will lead ideas from the first spark in the lab to launch campaigns seen around the world. Your job is to make the invisible visible: to take complex science and turn it into ideas people understand, feel and remember.

You will join the UK creative team, reporting to the Head of Creative, and work every day with creative strategists, designers, producers and the engineers behind the products. Forget the endless layers of approval that slow work down and kill good ideas by a thousand cuts. Here, you will present your ideas directly to Dyson's leadership, including James and Jake Dyson.

What you'll do

Connect with engineering and research teams early in development, investigating everything they do to find the detail that could become a compelling story
Create big, ownable ideas for global product launches and brand campaigns, across film, social, OOH, retail, digital and whatever channel the idea needs
Apply creative thinking and lateral problem solving to real business challenges beyond marketing, from product naming and portfolio strategy to how we explain new technology
Present and sell work with confidence to senior stakeholders and Dyson's leadership
Partner with production to craft work to the highest standard, staying close to the details from idea to delivery
Collaborate with teams in Malmesbury and Singapore to bring ideas to life in markets around the world
Raise the creative bar of the studio and help shape its culture as it grows

About You

An outstanding creative thinker (copywriter or art director) with a portfolio of work that made people stop, think and talk
Senior experience at a leading creative agency or in house team, with a record of launching ideas at global scale
Endlessly curious about how things work. You would rather spend an afternoon in a lab than in a meeting room
Brilliant at simplifying the complex without dumbing it down
Comfortable working across disciplines and media, from a hero film to a single line of product copy
A natural collaborator who can hold a room, take a challenge and build on other people's ideas
Restless, ambitious, positive, resilient and allergic to the obvious answer

The team you'll join

You will work alongside talent from some of the most respected agencies and brands in the world, including BBH, Wieden+Kennedy, adam&eve, BBC Creative, Accenture Song, Canva, Logitech, Converse and Beats by Dre.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Account Manager

The Company:

WPP Production is a leading creative production company, producing advertising and marketing content for many of the world’s most famous brands, across all media around the world. WPP Production was founded over 10 years ago and has grown from a start-up to over 4,000 people, across 28 cities worldwide and is now part of the WPP family. Our rapid growth continues to drive us forward making WPP Production an exciting place to work and a great place to achieve your career ambitions.

The Role

Reporting to the Senior Account Manager, the Account Manager will be a key part of the dedicated WPP Production team supporting JLR regional and retailer campaign activity.

Act as the day-to-day contact for JLR retailer and regional stakeholders, agency partners and WPP Production teams.
Work with the Senior Account Manager and Delivery Lead to sense-check incoming briefs, confirm scope, deliverables, timings, markets, approvals and production dependencies before work begins.
Coordinate the end-to-end production process: imagery sourcing and selection, master asset development, spec sheet validation visavis available asset toolkit , adaptation and localization, quality control and final delivery.
Manage approval stages for imagery, master assets and adaptations; capture feedback clearly, manage agreed feedback rounds and communicate any impact on scope or timing.
Coordinate closely with creative, studio, transcreation, digital and media teams to ensure all production dependencies are planned and tracked.
Build and maintain clear production plans, status reports, action logs, contact reports and agendas; ensure stakeholders have visibility of progress, risks and next steps.
Manage delivery against agreed WPP Production SLAs, proactively chasing delayed inputs, specifications and approvals, and escalating risks to the Senior Account Manager, Delivery Lead or Business Director where required.
Support workload triage across the team, ensuring straightforward work is appropriately handed over and complex or high-risk jobs are escalated early.
Ensure master and adapted assets meet agreed brand, technical and market requirements before delivery.
Develop strong, trusted relationships with client and agency stakeholders while maintaining a calm, solutions-focused approach to fast-moving campaign requirements.

Requirements

Automotive experience is essential; experience supporting JLR, premium automotive brands, retailer marketing or regional automotive accounts is highly desirable.
Proven experience in an account management, integrated agency or production role delivering multi-channel campaigns across print, digital, broadcast and/or retail environments.
Experience managing production workflows involving master creative, imagery selection, local market adaptations and transcreation/localisation.
Comfortable working across international accounts and multiple markets, ideally five or more, with numerous client, agency and production stakeholders.
Strong understanding of client approval processes, production specifications, asset delivery and the dependencies between creative, media, digital and production teams.
Excellent project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple jobs, work to tight deadlines, maintain accurate trackers and identify risks before they affect delivery.
Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive and client-focused, with the resilience to work effectively under pressure.

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Hi. We’re Article Group, a strategic advisory and creative studio.

That means we often work with product marketers at some of the most well-known tech companies (think: Google, Meta, Amazon, Salesforce etc.). It also means we’re a great partner for startups and early-stage companies looking to leverage our strategic and creative capabilities.

Our rapidly growing keynote business focuses on synthesizing visual storytelling with expert customer service. We craft bold presentations for some of the top industry leaders at brands like Amazon Web Services, AIG, and Crowdstrike.

We strive to make every slide and animation clear, beautiful, surprising, and useful. We want all of our speakers to be able to present with confidence, and aim to reduce friction in the keynote development process through the clarity that comes from a strong point of view.

Role description

The freelance Associate Creative Director, Design at Article Group leads creative concepting, visual styling, design, and client workshares on assigned technical keynote presentations and event collateral. You will work directly and autonomously with clients among your direct collaborators, and be accountable for creative problem-solving, design direction, PowerPoint presentation design and animation, and collaboration with other designers and animators. You will be accountable for selling through a consistent design direction for each asset you are assigned, while contributing to all client-facing deliverables in a “hands-on” manner. This is a leader/doer role.

You will drive creative excellence across design-centric workflows and deliverables. In close collaboration with Article Group management, you will represent Article Group to clients and own accountability for creative decisions. You will demonstrate consultative listening to grasp client objectives, persuasive presentation of creative concepts, and adaptive problem-solving when incorporating feedback.

Your background skews toward keynote and presentation design, art direction, and visual storytelling. You are capable of direct partnership with clients, including senior C-suite or VP executive speaker stakeholders. You can lead creative efforts as both a doer and delegator of tasks while giving concise, actionable feedback to collaborators of all levels. Ultimately, you are responsible for crafting and advocating for the integrity of the core creative vision of assigned deliverables with team members and clients.

This role requires advanced PowerPoint design capabilities. Candidates should be comfortable designing high-visibility executive-level presentations, designing polished slides from blank pages, and iterating rapidly in live client sessions.

This role frequently requires direct, 1:1 collaboration with clients. Designers will be expected to work with clients as partners in the creative process, and become trusted, embedded members of the client keynote development team.

This is a freelance, project-based contract role with variable hours based on client demand and event schedules. You will work in a remote environment. Travel for on-site events and rehearsals will be required. You will find success in this role if you are senior enough to design and iterate quickly in PowerPoint with a high taste level in close, personable collaboration with client stakeholders.

Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life.

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who lives at the intersection of data, psychology, and creativity. This role is not about making things “look nice.” It’s about building ad creatives that convert, scale, and keep working.

You’ll own creative strategy across paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) — turning customer insights, performance data, and trends into winning ad concepts that drive revenue. Our Role

Reporting to the Senior Creative Producer, the Creative Shoot Producer will work across the production and delivery of inspiring stills and video across campaign, print, digital, social and e-commerce channels, with particular responsibility for casting and video post-production.

You will oversee shoots from brief to final delivery, ensuring every asset reflects The White Company’s distinctive aesthetic and connects with our customer. With a strong eye for fashion and talent, you will translate creative direction into thoughtful casting and well-planned productions that bring our collections to life.

You will build relationships with model agencies, photographers, fashion stylists, directors, DOPs, editors and post-production partners. Working closely with Art Direction, Creative and Marketing, you will manage budgets, schedules and approvals, ensuring stills and moving image are considered together from the outset.

Highly organised and commercially astute, you will combine confident talent negotiation with a detailed understanding of both stills and video workflows, guiding projects through to delivery while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

What you'll be doing

Main duties include, but are not limited to:

Partner with Buying & Merchandising, Marketing and Creative to define seasonal campaign asset requirements and develop production plans, shot lists and detailed budgets for approval.
Manage pre-production, on-set production and logistics for UK and overseas shoots. Book creative teams, locations, studios and travel; manage call sheets, shoot schedules, samples and outfittings with relevant teams.
Plan stills and motion shoot schedules. Work with Art Direction, Styling, hair and make-up, photographers and DOPs to deliver the brief.
Manage casting for seasonal campaigns, e-commerce, social and video, translating creative briefs into clear talent requirements that reflect the brand, customer and collection.

Manage video post-production schedules and budgets, agreeing deliverables, edit milestones, review rounds and final delivery dates before each shoot.
Manage video editors, colourists, and sound specialist partners. Consolidate stakeholder feedback and secure approvals at each stage.
Oversee hero films, cutdowns and channel-specific versions, checking aspect ratios, durations, audio, captions and export specifications before delivery; deliver approved assets with accurate naming, version control and metadata to the DAM system.

The Skills & Experience That You’ll Need

Significant relevant production experience, ideally within fashion, retail or editorial, delivering stills and video from brief to final asset.
A strong visual eye and clear understanding of photography, styling, composition and brand storytelling.
Proven casting experience and established relationships with model agencies and creative talent, and confidence negotiating talent fees, usage rights and supplier contracts.
Substantial experience managing video post-production, including edit briefs, schedules, review rounds, grading, sound, graphics, captions and final delivery.
Proven ability to manage multiple productions, detailed budgets and competing deadlines, keeping stakeholders informed and approvals on track.
Excellent attention to detail, clear communication and a practical approach to solving problems; comfortable working independently and collaboratively, and supporting junior colleagues

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
We're hiring: Creative Director | Dubai | Full-time

TACTECH New Media
is a Dubai-based creative technology studio working where storytelling, design and technology meet. We create immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, brand campaigns and content for opening ceremonies and shows.

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision from first insight to final execution.

THE ROLE

Lead TACTECH's creative direction across immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, opening ceremonies, shows and campaigns. Bring the strategic thinking and conceptual discipline of an experienced agency creative leader to every brief, whether or not it is a campaign. Guide ideas from insight and concept through narrative, audience experience, visual development and final execution, in close collaboration with production and technology teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative strategy and concept leadership

Interpret client and agency briefs, uncover audience and business objectives, and establish a clear strategic creative rationale.
Develop original concepts, storylines, scripts, experience narratives, visitor journeys, creative treatments and presentations for corporate and entertainment projects.
Bring proven campaign thinking - audience insight, big ideas, messaging and consistency across touchpoints - to campaign assignments and apply that same strategic rigor to TACTECH's wider creative work.
Shape UX scripts, user flows and screen-by-screen interactions with designers and developers; define participation or game mechanics only when they add value to a relevant experience.

Art direction and content direction

Direct key visuals, styleframes, storyboards, moodboards, design systems, animation language and presentation materials across content, campaigns and experiences.
Guide creative storytelling and execution for corporate films, opening films, footage-led content, CGI, motion graphics, AI-assisted visuals and relevant live-action productions.
Shape how stories unfold across immersive and large-format screens, opening ceremonies, show sequences and interactive applications, choosing techniques for their creative value.
Protect brand accuracy, typography, visual hierarchy, narrative clarity and consistent creative quality from early concepts through final output.

Creative team leadership and integration

Brief, mentor and review the Art Director, designers, motion artists, and external creative specialists, providing clear and actionable feedback.
Work with the Production Manager to define creative disciplines, resource needs, quality benchmarks and review checkpoints; collaborate with Producers, Technology and Technical Leads to test feasibility early.
Continuously review freelance artists' portfolios, assess creative capabilities and recommend the right specialists for each assignment in coordination with production.
Use AI creative tools proficiently to visualize and communicate ideas through concepts, visual references, styleframes, storyboards and previsualization, while maintaining high creative standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

10+ years of creative experience, including a strong agency background with hands-on campaign concept development and senior creative leadership across experiential, digital, motion/CGI or content work.
A portfolio demonstrating personal ownership of strategy, concepts and finished work across corporate and entertainment assignments, including campaign work as well as content or experiences.
Strong strategic and conceptual judgment, storytelling and script/treatment skills, and the ability to turn complex briefs into distinctive ideas and audience experiences.
Working knowledge of interactive UX and occasional gamified experiences, animation, CGI, screen content and practical physical-digital production constraints.
Confident creative presentation, multidisciplinary team leadership and a collaborative approach to resource and technical feasibility planning.
Hands-on proficiency with contemporary AI-assisted creative tools, with strong judgment about quality, originality and practical application.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Creative ideas demonstrate audience understanding, strategic relevance and originality, whatever the format or channel.
Stories, art direction, UX intent and relevant interaction mechanics translate coherently from creative pitch through implementation.
Internal and external creative teams receive clear briefs, useful reviews and timely decisions; specialists are well matched to projects.
The work demonstrates strong craft and feasibility, strengthens client confidence and elevates the studio portfolio.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND COLLABORATION

Reporting line:
Managing Director
This is not a film-only director, conventional advertising art director, event-design/fabrication or game-studio position. TACTECH creates strategy-informed concepts, content and technology-led experiences; event operations and physical fabrication, when needed, are handled with specialist partners.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit a CV and a curated portfolio of 4-6 projects showing creative strategy or rationale, your personal concept contribution, the disciplines involved and the finished outcome. Include campaign work and relevant examples across content, immersive/interactive, corporate or entertainment projects.
Apply through the job post or send a direct email to : careers@tactech.digital

jobs.description:
An established UAE-based healthcare and wellness distribution company is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist
to design, execute, and optimise digital media strategies across a diverse portfolio of international product brands.
This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, focusing on building brand visibility, reaching the right consumers, driving engagement, and converting digital marketing investments into measurable commercial results.
You will work closely with Brand Management, Sales, E-commerce, and external partners to develop brand-specific digital strategies aligned with commercial objectives, product launches, consumer behaviour, and market opportunities.

What You Will Own

Brand Digital Strategy:
Design and execute digital media strategies for individual product brands, translating brand positioning, target audiences, and commercial priorities into actionable plans.
Media Planning & Budgeting:
Develop digital media plans, recommend channel investments, allocate approved budgets, and monitor spending effectiveness across brands.
Paid Media & Campaign Management:
Plan, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant digital platforms.
Performance Marketing:
Improve campaign effectiveness through audience targeting, bidding strategies, A/B testing, remarketing, and conversion optimisation.
SEO & SEM:
Develop and implement search strategies that strengthen product visibility, generate qualified traffic, and support customer acquisition.
Analytics & Reporting:
Analyse performance using GA4, Meta Insights, and other reporting tools, measuring reach, engagement, conversions, customer acquisition costs, and ROI.
Brand Content & Social Media:
Develop brand-specific digital content plans, coordinate creative production, and ensure consistency across digital platforms.
CRM & Consumer Engagement:
Support targeted email campaigns, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and marketing automation initiatives.
Influencer & Digital Partnerships:
Coordinate influencer campaigns and digital collaborations, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and measurable outcomes.
E-commerce Integration:
Work with e-commerce teams to drive traffic, improve conversion rates, and support online sales through effective digital campaigns.
Innovation & Optimisation:
Identify emerging digital trends, AI-powered tools, and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Compliance:
Ensure digital campaigns, advertising claims, and creative materials comply with applicable regulations and brand guidelines.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You can independently develop a digital media strategy and take ownership of its execution.
You understand how to adapt digital strategies to different brands, consumer segments, and commercial objectives.
You have personally managed advertising campaigns and digital media budgets.
You know how to translate performance data into practical decisions that improve campaign results.
You are commercially minded and understand how digital marketing supports brand growth and sales.
You combine creativity, analytical thinking, and hands-on execution.
You can effectively manage multiple brands, campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines.

Must Have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, or a related discipline.
5–7 years of progressive experience in digital marketing
, preferably in healthcare, nutraceuticals, wellness, consumer health, or FMCG.
Proven experience developing and executing digital media strategies across multiple brands or product categories.
Hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, paid social advertising, SEO, and SEM.
Demonstrated experience managing digital media budgets and optimising campaign performance.
Strong proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), digital performance reporting, and conversion analysis.
Experience with audience segmentation, remarketing, A/B testing, and customer acquisition strategies.
Working knowledge of CRM, email marketing, and automation platforms.
Strong analytical, project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Nice to Have

Experience managing digital campaigns for healthcare, nutraceutical, wellness, or other regulated consumer products.
Exposure to e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Noon, or Shopify.
Certifications in Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, HubSpot, or SEO.
Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
Experience using AI-powered marketing and automation solutions.

Interested?

If you can combine digital strategy, creative thinking, and performance marketing to deliver measurable brand growth, we would like to hear from you.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Candidates who can demonstrate successful digital media strategies, campaign results, and measurable business impact will be particularly encouraged to apply.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does Creative Technologist do at WPP Production?

A Creative Technologist at WPP Production is positioned at the crossroads of creativity and technology. Their primary role is to harness cutting-edge technological advancements to enhance and actualise creative visions. In collaboration with the Marketing Transformation Team, as well as with designers, developers, and other stakeholders, they ensure that tech-driven solutions are utilized to amplify the essence of creative content and effectively address client requirements. Essentially, a Creative Technologist integrates innovative technological tools and methods with artistic concepts, ensuring that the end product is both technologically advanced and creatively compelling within the framework of WPP Production's commitment to delivering superior content experiences. This role has a strong focus on AI.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to ideate, design, and developvisually stunning projects using a mix of AI, 3D, and retouching techniques.
Harness the power of AI image generation tools to create innovative visualsfor various campaigns and products.
Design, model, and render 3D assets that can be integrated with AI-generated imagery or used independently.
Expertly retouch and enhance photos, ensuring they meet the highest quality standards for both print and digital platforms.
Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI image generation, 3D design, and retouching techniques to ensure cutting-edge output.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
Troubleshoot technical issues related to visual projects and provide solutions.
Stable Diffusion - highly desirable

Requirements

AI Image Generation: Experience with AI-based image generation tools and platforms, with an understanding of underlying algorithms.
3D Expertise: Proficiency in industry-leading 3D software like Blender, Maya,or Cinema 4D.
Retouching Skills: Mastery in retouching using software such as AdobePhotoshop, with a keen eye for detail.
Innovation: A knack for conceptualizing and executing visually compelling solutions by combining AI, 3D, and retouching techniques.
Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work seamlessly with designers, developers, and other stakeholders.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated with the ever-evolving fields of AI, 3D
Stable Diffusion - highly desirable

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

THE ROLE

We're building an AI-powered entertainment studio producing addictive vertical micro-drama series for US audiences, primarily women aged 35–55.

We're looking for a creative director with exceptional storytelling instincts, strong cinematic taste, and a deep understanding of human emotions.

Your mission is simple: turn good scripts into emotionally powerful episodes that people can't stop watching.

You'll work with screenwriters, AI video creators, and editors, taking creative ownership from script review to the final finished episode.

You won't need to write the scripts or generate every video yourself. Your role is to guide the creative execution, identify what needs improvement, and ensure every episode meets our standards.

No AI experience? No problem. We’re looking for exceptional storytellers and filmmakers, not AI experts. If you’re a talented screenwriter or director, we’ll teach you everything you need to know about AI filmmaking technologies.

We believe AI is opening up incredible new opportunities for creative professionals, allowing them to bring their ideas to life faster and with fewer traditional production limitations. You’ll have the opportunity to learn cutting-edge tools, develop valuable new skills, and become part of the next generation of filmmaking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Script Review & Creative Direction

  • Review season storylines and individual episode screenplays.

  • Evaluate storytelling, emotional impact, character motivations, hooks, and cliffhangers.

  • Approve scripts or provide specific, actionable feedback to screenwriters.

  • Add directing instructions only when necessary. If the script is already strong and production-ready, approve it without unnecessary changes.

2. Direct AI Video Production

  • Establish the visual style and creative standards for each series.

  • Guide AI video creators on cinematography, framing, character performance, lighting, and emotional delivery.

  • Review generated footage and identify scenes or shots that need improvement.

  • Maintain visual consistency and quality across episodes.

3. Editing & Final Approval

  • Review episode edits for pacing, tension, emotional impact, music, sound design, and visual storytelling.

  • Give clear, prioritized feedback to editors.

  • Approve final episodes before release.

  • Ensure the finished video delivers the intended emotional experience.

4. Production Quality & Efficiency

  • Work with multiple AI video creators and editors.

  • Help the team increase production speed without sacrificing creative quality.

  • Identify recurring production problems and improve workflows.

  • Use audience feedback and retention data to improve future episodes.

Growth path
from here is Senior AI Video Creator → Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023:
In this role, tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney and Flux are part of the production workflow — not side experiments. AI gets you to footage faster; your judgment decides whether the hook works, the product looks real, the edit holds attention and the finished asset is ready to ship.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Video Creator, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. You will own AI video production across cold-traffic ads on Meta, TikTok and YouTube and product videos on Puffy.com, covering concept and script, image generation, motion, editing, compositing, colour and audio. This role exists to turn already-scaled media spend into creative that converts, building the production pipeline that carries a hook from script to shippable asset at volume without the craft slipping.

The Career Accelerator

You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.

The scope is scarce:
very few AI Video Creators get simultaneous ownership of video creative for both paid advertising and the product page. And a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.
Your first 12 months:
build the prompt and reference library for character and material consistency. Produce direct-response ads at volume for Meta and TikTok cold prospecting, multiple concepts per week. Solve character consistency across shots, including AI-generated spokespeople delivering to camera. Produce realism-first product video for Puffy.com from real product photography. Get material behaviour right — foam that compresses under a hand and recovers on release, fabric that moves like fabric. Master the invisible edit, blending generated footage with stock and shot footage until the AI elements are indistinguishable. Read CTR, hold rates and drop-off points and iterate the hook against what audiences actually do. Shape the future of AI video at Puffy, where creative is the binding constraint on a media engine that is already scaled.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Entire Chain, Script to Shipped Asset

You concept it, generate it, cut it, score it, and ship it.
You design the visual worlds, control the motion, cut for retention, and layer the voiceover, music and sound design — no handoff, no queue, no waiting on someone else's render. You choose which model solves which production problem, and you decide when footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production, and when the right call is to regenerate.
The standard is performance, not applause. Every asset is a hypothesis: with the broader marketing team, you review CTR, hold rates, drop-off points and on-page conversion, iterate the hook, and bring your cuts into review with the Director of Marketing.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Creator Whose Work Decides Whether It Converts

In most companies, video people make things that look good and hope somebody tests them. Here, you're the person whose first 3 seconds decide whether a cold audience stops scrolling, and whose product clip decides whether a shopper believes what's on screen is what arrives in the box. When an ad drives outbound CTR but not orders, your read on where it broke — hook, promise, or landing experience, is the reason the next iteration wins. You'll build the judgment to tell shippable generated footage from footage a shopper quietly distrusts and the direct-response instinct for where proof lands in a 30-second ad and where it kills the momentum. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency turnaround time in front of you.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

jobs.description:
Subko
is seeking a concept-forward Brand Strategist + Storyteller
to build and safeguard our brand presence in the UAE (Al Serkal Avenue, Dubai). This role bridges big-picture conceptual thinking with high-craft written narrative and agile content execution.

This role requires you to be a strategic architecture (Brand Strategy, Content Ecosystem, and Partnerships Strategy) and also own narrative execution (Tone of Voice, Copywriting, Campaign Storytelling, and Agile Content Creation).

While offline community events and physical venue management are handled by separate operational/community teams, you are the master narrator
, turning product drops, design choices, craft provenance, and brand partnerships into captivating, world-class content across all digital and brand touchpoints.

Core Responsibilities

Pillar 1: Brand, Content & Partnerships Strategy (65% Focus)

Brand Strategy & Localization: Adapt Subko’s core positioning for the UAE market—translating South Asian craft and origin stories for Dubai’s design-forward, specialty coffee, and cultural audience without over-explaining or diluting the brand identity.
Content Strategy Architecture: Define and maintain Subko UAE’s multi-platform content strategy (Instagram, TikTok, emerging channels). Build structured content pillars around Product, Craft & Provenance, Culture, and Behind-the-Scenes.
Strategic Partnerships: Identify and shape high-impact brand partnerships, co-branding initiatives, and cultural collaborations in Dubai (design, lifestyle, art, and hospitality entities).
Cross-Market Alignment: Collaborate closely with Subko India’s Brand and Design HQ to ensure global narrative consistency while tailoring GCC-specific content strategies.

Pillar 2: Content Storytelling, Tone of Voice & Execution (35% Focus)

Master Tone of Voice & Copywriting: Own all outward-facing written copy across campaigns, product launches, social channels, and in-store collateral; executing high-standard written copy in alignment with Subko’s brand voice and writing guidelines.
Product Drop & Narrative Arcs: Turn every launch into a multi-phase narrative journey (Pre-launch tease Launch moment post-launch depth), tying coffee origins, bakery items, and design drops back into Subko’s broader universe.
Creative Direction & Production: Lead visual and narrative direction for shoots. Write creative briefs for photographers and videographers and build aesthetic reference boards for Subko storytelling.
Agile Content Creation: Independently capture and edit quick-turnaround, high-craft digital content for time-sensitive moments using mobile creative tools (CapCut, Lightroom, Canva, Premiere, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. 

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

  • Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
  • Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
  • Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
  • Push bey

As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

Why You’ll Love It Here
