jobs.title: Head of Creative
jobs.description:
About Trip

TRIP’s mission is to create calm in the everyday chaos for our community, offering next-generation wellness products to power their lifestyle and nurture mental wellbeing.

Co-founders, husband and wife team Olivia and Daniel discovered plant-based wellness after a transformative personal experience and decided to launch TRIP in 2019 to bring the most delicious, highest quality functional drinks and supplements to millions of people globally.

Now the world’s #1 Calming Beverage Brand, TRIP’s award-winning drinks and wellness products are crafted with botanicals and adaptogens to help people relax, unwind and find balance. Since launch, TRIP has rapidly expanded from the UK to across Europe and North America, generating over $100 million in sales. TRIP products are now available in leading supermarkets, natural retailers and online.

Our vision is to become the global leader in calming drinks and supplements. Synonymous with calm in the same way Red Bull is with energy. We move fast, think big and are committed to becoming the defining brand for a generation who drinks less but prioritises mental wellbeing more than ever. There has never been a better time to join our incredible team and be part of the movement!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Head of Creative & Design to lead and evolve TRIP’s global creative identity as we continue to scale across the UK, US and beyond.

We need someone who is equally comfortable setting the creative vision and opening Illustrator or Photoshop and getting into the work themselves.

You’ll operate as a true player-coach: leading the team, setting the creative standard and shaping how the function scales, while remaining closely involved in the hands-on development and execution of TRIP’s most important creative work.

Graphic design craft is central to the role. You’ll personally contribute to concepts and execution across campaigns, brand assets, packaging, retail, POS, digital, social and e-commerce. You’ll also bring a strong understanding of creative production, including planning and directing photoshoots and taking creative concepts from initial idea through to production and final execution, ensuring everything we put into the world feels unmistakably TRIP.

As the business grows, you’ll also help build the creative team, processes and capabilities needed to support an increasingly global brand without losing the pace, quality or creative edge that has helped make TRIP successful.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Creative & Design

Remain actively involved in the day-to-day creative output of the team, personally designing and developing key brand assets where required.
Take ideas from concept through to execution across graphic design, campaign creative, Photoshoots, retail, POS, digital, social, e-commerce and brand communications.
Bring exceptional graphic design craft, with a strong eye for typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling.
Work confidently in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop, rather than solely directing others to execute.
Develop and refine campaign concepts, key visuals, toolkits and brand systems that can scale across multiple channels and markets.
Create and evolve design systems that allow the wider team to move quickly while maintaining a consistently high creative standard.
Get close to the detail, whether that means refining a layout, challenging typography, developing a visual route or improving an asset before it goes live.
Support packaging, retail and shopper creative, ensuring TRIP stands out both on shelf and across physical retail environments.
Partner with content and production teams on photography, video and campaign shoots, from concept development through to final execution.

Creative Leadership

Work directly with TRIP’s founders to translate their creative vision into compelling concepts and high-quality execution across all brand touchpoints.
Lead, inspire and develop TRIP’s in-house creative team, setting a high bar for both ideas and execution.
Provide clear creative direction while remaining close enough to the work to coach, challenge and improve it.
Balance hands-on design with team leadership, mentoring and creative decision-making.
Build a culture where designers have strong ownership of their craft and are continuously raising the standard of the work.
Review and approve creative output across channels, maintaining consistency, quality and attention to detail.
Build and evolve the creative team structure as TRIP grows, identifying where additional capabilities should sit in-house versus with freelancers or agencies.
Manage creative budgets, freelance support and production resources across UK and US requirements.

Brand & Creative Vision

Own and evolve TRIP’s global visual identity while protecting the distinctive look and feel that has made the brand successful.
Translate TRIP’s brand strategy into bold, culturally relevant creative ideas that work across markets and channels.
Ensure the brand continues to evolve rather than becoming overly rigid or formulaic as the business scales.
Lead creative development across UK, US and global markets, adapting execution where needed while maintaining a coherent global identity.
Stay close to culture, design, consumer behaviour and emerging creative trends to ensure TRIP remains distinctive and relevant.
Develop a strong understanding of what best-in-class creative looks like across packaging, retail, Meta, Amazon, email, web, shopper marketing and emerging channels.

Creative Operations & Scale

Build creative processes that allow the team to move quickly without compromising quality.
Improve workflows, briefing, feedback and production processes across the wider business.
Work closely with Marketing, Growth, E-commerce, Sales and Shopper teams to translate commercial objectives into strong creative solutions.
Help teams across the business understand how to use TRIP’s brand and creative assets effectively.
Identify opportunities to introduce new tools, technology and AI into the creative process where they genuinely improve speed, quality or output.

About You

You have significant experience across graphic design and creative, ideally within FMCG, beauty, lifestyle, wellness or another design-led consumer brand.
You are a hands-on designer first and foremost, with the leadership experience to operate at Head of level.
Your portfolio demonstrates a strong mix of work you have personally designed and executed, alongside creative projects you have art directed, including beautifully executed photoshoots that showcase your ability to bring creative concepts to life from initial vision through to final production.
You have exceptional graphic design fundamentals across typography, layout, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.
You are highly proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, with working knowledge of Premiere Pro and/or After Effects beneficial.
You are comfortable moving between high-level creative thinking and detailed execution — from shaping a campaign idea to refining an individual asset.
You have experience developing creative across a broad mix of channels including brand campaigns, digital, social, retail, POS, e-commerce and packaging.
You understand how creative needs to flex by channel rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach.
You have experience leading and developing designers while still remaining actively involved in the work yourself.
You have helped build creative teams, processes and ways of working within a growing or fast-moving organisation.
You are commercially minded and understand how great creative supports both brand building and business performance.
You are comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders and challenging constructively when needed.
You have experience directing lifestyle and/or product photography and working closely with production partners.
Experience working across the UK and US is highly desirable, particularly within consumer brands.
You are curious about emerging creative technology and confident using AI tools where they can genuinely improve the creative process.
You thrive in fast-paced environments, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance multiple projects from concept through to production.

THE PACKAGE

Lovely, bright and spacious office 1 minute from Notting Hill Gate station, surrounded by TRIP pastel-coloured houses!

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;

About Pechka

Pechka is a Dubai food brand built on Russian and Eastern European home-style cooking. We started with pies baked to family recipes. Today we have a café and bakery in Dubai Marina, delivery and pickup from Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Arjan, and our own production facility supplying wholesale and B2B customers, including retail chains.
Customers order through our website and app (with a rewards programme) and through Talabat, Deliveroo, Careem, Noon, Keeta and Instashop. We also cater corporate and private events, and Pechka Market delivers Eastern European groceries alongside our food.
The role

You will own the Pechka brand and make sure it feels the same everywhere: in the café, in delivery, on packaging, on social media, at events and pop-ups, and on supermarket shelves. You will lead a team of three (digital and SEO, delivery-platform marketing, content and community) plus freelancers, reporting directly to the owner. You will work closely with the FMCG manager, sales, kitchen, production and operations.
What you’ll do

Brand
Develop the brand platform: positioning, values, story, audiences, personality and tone of voice in English and Russian
Shape the brand architecture across Pechka, Pechka Market, catering and the production range, and own naming and positioning of new lines
Maintain the visual identity and brand book, and approve all layouts: menus, packaging, signage, website, app, advertising and B2B materials
Act as creative director: brief and sign off photographers, designers and agencies
Write brand standards for partners and franchisees
Study customers and the market to understand how Pechka is perceived and where to go next

Content and social
Plan and run photo and video shoots for dishes, catering and products
Create content hands-on: short videos (Reels, TikTok), social graphics, banners, menus and presentations
Own Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Telegram, including content plans, community replies and user-generated content

PR, events and pop-ups
Work with media and pitch stories (family recipes, seasonal launches, new products)
Select, brief and measure bloggers and influencers
Build partnerships and take part in cultural, charity and community projects
Organise tastings, launches, masterclasses and celebrations such as Maslenitsa
Help run pop-up stores: concept, stand design, range and pricing, logistics, promotion and results
Own the brand’s reputation, including crisis communications

Products, menu and pricing (with kitchen and production)
Propose new dishes and products based on sales, feedback and trends
Plan seasonal menus and launches a year ahead (Maslenitsa, Easter, Ramadan, New Year)
Run tastings, keep costings current, control food cost and margin
Propose prices for each channel, allowing for commissions and retailer margins

Packaging and retail
Own packaging concept, design, suppliers and cost for delivery, catering and retail
Work with the FMCG manager to meet UAE labelling and product registration requirements
Define how the brand looks on shelf and in B2B: labels, catalogues, buyer presentations and trade-show stands (e.g. Gulfood)

Delivery platforms and direct orders
Manage relationships with platform account managers and keep menus, photos, descriptions and prices accurate
Approve platform ads and promotions, measure returns and stop what doesn’t pay
Track ratings, cancellations and complaints and fix causes with operations
Run advertising on social media, Google and with influencers; grow orders through our own website and app; oversee SEO and Google Business Profiles

Reviews, loyalty and CRM
Organise replies to reviews on Google and delivery platforms in English and Russian
Handle complex customer cases and turn repeat complaints into fixes
Run the loyalty programme (tiers, cashback points, welcome and birthday offers, gift cards, promo codes) and track its economics
Build email, SMS and WhatsApp communications: segments, trigger flows and win-back campaigns
Track retention, order frequency, average order value and churn

Catering
Build the catering offer with the kitchen and sales, prepare sales materials, and generate leads through digital channels, outreach and venue partnerships

Budget and team
Own the marketing budget across all business lines and report monthly on spend and results
Lead and develop the marketing team and freelancers

Note: negotiations with retail chains and B2B clients are handled by the FMCG manager and sales team and are not part of this role.
Your first 90 days

Month 1: a brand audit across every touchpoint, an audit of the loyalty programme, and meetings with key internal teams and platform account managers
Month 2: first fixes (consistent menus, photos and prices across channels, a review-response routine, a 12-month seasonal calendar, refreshed catering materials)
Month 3: the brand concept for the coming years and a 12-month marketing plan with budget, targets and loyalty plan, plus a proposal for team structure

jobs.description:
This role is part of our Usersnap team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

Profile Overview

Usersnap is building AI-driven capabilities into the core of the product, from automated setup to intelligent surveys, contextual analysis, and reporting that generates itself based on connectors. We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead / Engineering Manager to lead the small engineering team that ships these capabilities, and to set the technical direction while doing it.

This is a player-coach role. You'll write and review code, make architecture calls, and define what "good" looks like for AI-native development. You'll also own team coordination, delivery timelines, workload allocation, and follow-through, so that work planned is work shipped, reliably and at production quality.

This is a full-time, engineering-led role. It is not combined with product management: the technical leadership scope is substantial on its own, and you'll partner with Product rather than absorb it.

AI capability is becoming core to Usersnap's product and go-to-market, especially as we move upmarket. You'll be the person who makes sure it ships well.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • You'll have established a clear delivery rhythm for the team: shared priorities, realistic timelines, visible workload, and projects that get followed through to launch
  • You'll have assessed the current state of the codebase, tooling, and practices, and set out a concrete engineering bar covering observability, testing, security, and architecture
  • You'll have shipped at least one AI-powered feature to production with the team, from prototype through launch, using timeboxed AI development
  • You'll have built a strong working relationship with Product and the rest of the company, and be seen as a reliable owner of ambiguous, technically complex work
  • You'll have raised the team's standards while keeping people motivated and engaged

Your responsibilities

Team leadership and delivery

  • Own team coordination, delivery timelines, workload allocation, and project follow-through for a small engineering team
  • Keep work moving: break down ambiguous goals, sequence them with Product, flag slippage early, and make sure commitments are met
  • Give clear, constructive technical feedback in code review, design discussions, and 1:1s, and raise standards without demotivating people
  • Grow the team's capability, including how we use AI tooling to work faster without lowering quality

Technical leadership

  • Assess the current engineering bar and raise it. Define what "good" looks like for AI-native development, and make it the shared standard
  • Set and enforce expectations in five areas:
    • Observability: logging, monitoring, and tracing that make AI behavior, cost, and failures visible
    • Testing: strong test coverage and automated-testing rigor, including evaluation of AI outputs
    • Security and compliance: secure-by-default practices, as we move upmarket
    • Scalable architecture and data pipelines: designs that hold up as usage and integrations grow
    • Timeboxing: practical limits on AI development work, so exploration stays bounded and ships
  • Own or steward key architecture decisions, including model selection and integration approach, and the tradeoffs between quality, cost, and latency
  • Flag technical risks early, especially around AI reliability, cost, and edge-case behavior

jobs.title: (Senior) Creative Strategist - Social first (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Was Du Bei Uns Machen Wirst

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?
Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Creative Strategist Paid Social bei Zasta bringst du Leute, die beim Wort „Steuererklärung“ sofort weiterscrollen, dazu, anzuhalten, die App zu laden und loszulegen. Wie? Mit Ads auf TikTok und Instagram, die mutig, lustig und auch mal provokant sind. Hier darfst du dich richtig austoben.
Das Beste daran: Wir bauen gerade unsere Inhouse Agency auf, und du gestaltest sie von Grund auf mit, von Prozessen über Formate bis zur Arbeitsweise.
Du bekommst viel Freiraum für neue Creative Angles, testest, was wirklich funktioniert, und bringst große Ideen auch mal ins TV.

Deine Aufgaben

Paid Social ist dein Zuhause: Rund 80 % deiner Zeit drehen sich um Ads auf TikTok und Instagram. Du entwickelst laufend neue Ideen, Hooks und Formate und bringst sie schnell live.
Zielgruppe verstehen: Du weißt, was unsere Zielgruppe scrollt, teilt und kommentiert. Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus Creatives, die sich nicht wie Werbung anfühlen.
Ideen in Serie: Du machst auch langweilige Themen interessant. Steuer sind nicht unbedingt ein Scroll-Stopper. Deine Ads schon!"
Daten, Tests, Learnings: Du schaust täglich, was performt. Du testest Varianten gegeneinander und lässt jedes Learning direkt ins nächste Konzept fließen.
Eng im Team: Du bist die Brücke zwischen Performance Marketing, Data und Agenturen, also zwischen „Was sagen die Daten?“ und „Was machen wir jetzt Geiles daraus?“.
Und manchmal: TV. Auch das Fernsehen ist für uns ein wichtiger Kanal. Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, mit denen wir neue Zielgruppen erschließen und unsere bestehenden Zielgruppen weiter ausbauen.
Produktion: Du begleitest die Produktion von Anfang bis Ende. Neben der Entwicklung deiner Konzepte bist du bei den Drehs dabei und führst Regie. Mit deinem Feedback zu den fertigen Assets sorgst du am Ende dafür, dass Konzept, Tonalität und Umsetzung stimmen

Was Du Idealerweise Mitbringst

Fundierte Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Concepting oder Kampagnenentwicklung, idealerweise im digitalen Performance-Umfeld.
Du lebst Paid Social und hast nachweislich erfolgreiche Creatives für TikTok und Instagram entwickelt. Ein Portfolio zeigst du gern.
Du kennst den Meta und Tik Tok Ads Manager und übersetzt Daten, Insights und Zielgruppenpsychologie in Ideen, die Leads bringen.
Du bist immer on top of Social-Trends und denkst in Umsetzung statt in Slides: lieber heute drei Ideen live als nächsten Monat eine perfekte.
Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau, sicher mit englischen Marketing-Begriffen.
TV-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Was Wir Dir Bieten

Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet.
Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst.
Tapetenwechsel inklusive - bei Zasta hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen am Stück innerhalb Europas zu arbeiten.

Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben.

Dein Kontakt Bei Zasta

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über jobs@zasta.de schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet
. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

Über uns
Zasta wurde 2017 gegründet und ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App-Stores. Unsere Software ermöglicht es jedem Steuerzahler ohne großen Aufwand eine professionelle Steuererklärung einzureichen. Unsere Plattform arbeitet mit echten Steuerberatern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder das beste Ergebnis erhält - auch ohne Steuerwissen. Über 2 Millionen Nutzer vertrauen bereits in unsere App. Komm auch du mit auf unsere Reise, ein nerviges Finanzthema in einen freudigen Geldregen zu verwandeln.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

Job Purpose

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service, working with our UK teams from Hungary. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. Our clients include eBay, easyJet, Open Ai and Google.

We are looking for an AI Designer & Creative Technologist to join our creative team. The role has two halves: delivering AI-led creative work on live client projects, and building the tools and workflows that make the wider agency faster at it. The client work is varied, from fast-turnaround BAU creative responses to in-person creative sprints and full campaign productions across global markets, and generative AI now runs through most of it.

On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. On the technology side, you will spot the repetitive, manual parts of how our designers work and build things that remove them: automation pipelines, scripts, plugins and small internal tools.

This is a hands-on role and we are open to all levels of experience: what matters is the quality of your work and your judgement about when and how to use these tools. The scope of the role, from how much you lead to how much you guide others, will be shaped around the experience you bring. You will work day to day with creative directors, account teams and clients in the UK, mostly remotely, and contribute to creative sprints and workshops, in person where possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Turn creative briefs into AI-generated and AI-enhanced imagery, video and motion across social, paid, digital and campaign work
Build and refine prompts and workflows across image and video generation tools, keeping a library of what works per client
Finish AI output in Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro so it sits seamlessly alongside photography, design and live action

Fluent English, with confidence explaining your process and presenting to creative directors, account teams and clients

Curious, experimental and self-directed when a tool or workflow doesn’t exist yet

jobs.title: Senior Creative Lead (8+ years)
jobs.description:
Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

Random Studio Diversity & Inclusion Statement

At Random Studio, we believe that an inclusive work environment and a diverse team are key to creating fresh and inspiring work. We’re looking for candidates who enrich our culture and challenge the status quo. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work, and we strive to provide all candidates with an unbiased and accessible recruitment process. If you require assistance due to a disability when applying please let us know in your application so we can accommodate your needs.

and run it

You'll go on location with a camera, get the footage and photos, edit them into content that performs, then plan how one shoot becomes a month of posts. You'll own content from the idea to the results.

This role isn't only for a videographer, and it isn't only for a social media manager. We want someone who's comfortable doing both.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist – D2C
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (D2C / DTC) at NUTRICOOK — own every ad we run for a category-leading lifestyle kitchen appliance brand scaling its direct-to-consumer business.

Who we are

NutriCook is a leading home and kitchen appliance brand headquartered in Dubai, with a fast-growing D2C (DTC) business. We focus on healthy cooking: air fryers, pressure cookers, indoor grills, ovens, food prep and cookware.
We are a category leader across the Middle East, and in 2027 we launch into Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia and India. Our own direct-to-consumer channel is already a meaningful part of the business. Our objective is to multiply it, and creative is the single biggest lever we have.
We are a lean team. If you own something here, you genuinely own it.

Why this role exists

Our D2C business has a ceiling on it, and the ceiling is our ads. Not our product, not our traffic, not our agency's media buying. Our creative.
Too much of it is AI-generated and it looks like it. We don't produce enough of it. And nobody wakes up owning it. Look at what Caraway and IM8 put out: that is the bar. Ads built on a real insight about a real person, made properly, in enough volume to keep testing and keep winning.
You will not inherit a creative engine or a production setup. You are building it.

What this job is, and what it is not

·         You own the idea.
You decide what we say, to whom, and why it will make them stop and buy.
·         You direct, you do not edit.
You brief and manage creators and editors to produce the work.
·         You build the bench.
You find, brief and manage the creators, editors and freelancers who make the work.
·         You don't buy media.
Our agency runs the buying. You own what they run.
·         You don't make brand films.
This is direct response. Every ad has a job, and the job is to sell.
What you will do

·        Know our products and customers properly. Mine reviews, returns, support tickets and competitors' reviews for real objections and real moments of delight.
·        Build a hook library and a point of view on what we should say, backed by evidence, not taste.
·        Write tight briefs: hook, angle, objection, proof and format, before anything is shot.
·        Source, cast and direct UGC creators so the output is usable first time.
·        Ship a steady stream of genuinely new concepts, not recuts, and grow the active ad library to 200+.
·        Run structured tests with a stated hypothesis. Read hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative. Kill fast, scale winners, build the next five variations.
·        Work with the agency on ROAS: they own the buying, you own the creative that makes it work.
·        Make sure landing pages deliver what the ad promises, and run simple CRO tests to lift conversion.

What we need from you

·        3+ years owning performance ad creative on Meta and TikTok for a D2C or DTC e-commerce brand, or at an agency serving them.
·        A portfolio of ads you personally conceived and briefed, with the insight, the test and the numbers behind them.
·        Hands-on experience briefing and directing UGC creators.
·        Fluency in creative performance data: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, cost per result. You can explain why an ad failed, not just that it did.
·        Strong writing: hooks, scripts, ad copy.
·        Proven volume: dozens of concepts a quarter, not a handful a year.
·        A bias for action. You chase the creator, fix the edit and get it live.

Nice to have

·        Home, kitchen, food or daily-use product experience
·        Smart use of AI tools as an accelerator, knowing where they stop being good enough
·        Arabic, or experience making creative for this region
·        Static and motion design literacy, enough to art-direct

This job is not for you if

·        Your ads have been made mostly by AI with light human direction.
·        You've run social content rather than direct-response ads for a DTC brand.
·        You need a creative director above you to decide the angle.
·        You brief an agency and leave them to it. Here you own the output, not the handover.

How we measure you

·         Yours alone:
new concepts shipped per month, active ad library on the path to 200+, hook and hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative, and win rate against control.
·         Shared with the agency:
ROAS and cost per acquisition.
·         The point of the role:
incremental D2C revenue growth.
What we offer

·        Full ownership of the creative behind a real, growing D2C business
·        A product people genuinely love, which makes the creative job easier and more fun
·        Real budget, real volume and direct access to leadership
·        Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, medical insurance, annual air ticket and UAE visa as per company policy

How to apply

1. Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions.
2. Within 48 hours, email three ads you personally conceived and briefed to hr@caliberbrands.com with the subject line "My Best Ad". Links, files or screen recordings are fine. For one of them, tell us the insight, what you were trying to prove, what it spent and what it returned.

We only review applications that include the ads. The ads matter more than the CV.

Social Media & Content Lead

Dubai | Full-Time | On-Site

About Masterminds

Masterminds Education is a premium education group operating in Dubai and California.

Our educational model combines highly personalized learning in groups of just 5–6 students with strong academics, languages, music, physical development, STEAM and innovation, and a neuroscience-informed approach to education.

We are now bringing our organic social media capability fully in-house
across:
Masterminds Early Learning Center – Dubai
Masterminds VIP Micro-School – Dubai
Masterminds Academy – California

We are looking for someone who can understand a distinctive and sophisticated educational model and translate it into compelling, premium social content for parents.

The Role

This is a hands-on role combining social media strategy, storytelling, content creation and production
.

You will own the organic social presence across our brands: developing the narrative, content pillars and calendar while also personally creating much of the content.

The role goes well beyond documenting school activities. We want someone who can understand why
something happening inside a classroom matters and turn it into a story that helps parents understand what makes Masterminds different.

Key responsibilities include:
Develop and execute the organic social media strategy across our UAE and US brands
Build clear content pillars, recurring series and campaigns rather than disconnected posts
Maintain a consistent brand narrative while adapting content for different age groups and markets
Shoot and edit high-quality video and photography
Produce compelling Reels, short-form video and YouTube Shorts
Write excellent English copy and captions
Identify strong stories from classrooms, teachers, curriculum, students and school life
Work with academic teams to understand the educational thinking behind the content
Manage the content calendar and maintain consistent output
Monitor community engagement and respond appropriately
Track reach, engagement, follower growth and qualified organic enquiries
Use performance data and audience feedback to continuously improve the content strategy
Maintain the premium visual identity and tone of the Masterminds brand

Channel Priorities

Primary
Instagram
Facebook

Supporting
LinkedIn
YouTube Shorts

Secondary / exploratory
TikTok
Snapchat
X / Twitter
Other emerging platforms where there is a clear strategic opportunity

Who We Are Looking For

3+ years of relevant social media and content creation experience
, with meaningful ownership of both strategy and execution
Strong portfolio demonstrating video, photography, copywriting and social storytelling
Proven experience growing organic engagement for a brand
Strong short-form video shooting and editing capability
Excellent professional English and strong copywriting skills
Strong understanding of Instagram/Facebook
Ability to work independently across multiple brands and priorities
Strong visual judgment and understanding of premium brand positioning
Ability to understand a complex offering and translate it into clear, compelling content

Experience in premium education, particularly private/international schools, or boarding schools, would be highly desirable
.

Comfort with AI tools is welcome, but AI should support rather than drive the creative process. We are looking for authentic, human-centered storytelling rooted in real classrooms, real educators and real school experiences, not content that feels generic or AI-generated.

However, strong lifestyle content alone is not sufficient. The successful candidate needs to be intellectually curious enough to understand Masterminds’ educational philosophy, curriculum and differentiators and communicate them accurately and compellingly to parents.

Additional language capability, particularly French or Russian, would be an advantage. Professional proficiency in Russian would be a strong advantage, as Russian-speaking families are an important audience segment for Masterminds and we periodically develop dedicated Russian-language content and campaigns.

This is primarily an on-site Dubai role

inquiry@masterminds.ae

2–3 examples of content you personally conceptualized, created or managed
Your role in the strategy and production
Measurable results where available

The most relevant brand/account you have personally managed and your role in both strategy and content creation

jobs.title: Specialist, Performance Marketing - instashop
jobs.description:
instashop, headquartered in Dubai, is the leading online local marketplace in the UAE and Egypt . Since joining the Delivery Hero family in 2020, the global leader in online food delivery and q-commerce, instashop has been setting the standard for excellence and convenience in the region.

With a dynamic and motivated team fueled by passion and innovation, every day at instashop is an opportunity for growth and success. We champion inclusivity, diversity and collaboration, creating an environment where everyone’s achievements are celebrated and where success is the only way forward. As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey.

Job Description

This is an individual contributor role on the Performance Marketing team. You will own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across channels, manage budgets, and drive customer acquisition for instashop.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing at instashop on Marcomms strategy, incentive tracking, and business performance analysis, but also work as a dotted line with Talabat’s performance marketing lead. This is a hybrid role: part campaign executor, part strategic analyst. You need to be comfortable switching between both.

The team expects you to run lean. That means embedding AI into your workflow, cutting manual steps wherever possible, and operating at a pace that matches the business.

Campaign Execution

Own end-to-end campaign setup, bidding, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels.
Take creatives live, test new formats, and iterate based on performance data.
Manage daily budget allocation and pacing to hit CAC targets.
Monitor campaign health and flag issues before they compound.

Performance Analysis

Analyse campaign performance across the full funnel, from impression to conversion.
Build and maintain regular performance reports for the Head of Marketing and senior stakeholders across the two main markets (UAE & Egypt)
Track incentive performance and contribute to business performance reviews.
Identify CAC efficiency opportunities and bring data-backed recommendations.

Experimentation

Design and run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, bids, and landing experiences.
Document test hypotheses, results, and learnings in a structured way.
Propose new experiments based on platform signals, competitive benchmarks, and your own analysis.

Strategy and Marcomms Collaboration

Work closely with the Head of Marketing at instashop on marketing communications planning and calendar.
Support incentive design and tracking, aligning promotional activity with acquisition goals.
Contribute to quarterly planning with performance data and channel insights.

Qualifications

Platform Depth

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structures, bidding strategies, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative best practices.
Working knowledge of TikTok Ads: smart campaigns, TopView, In-Feed, and short-form content performance patterns.
Familiarity with how short-form content (Reels, TikToks) behaves differently in paid vs organic and how to use that to brief or iterate on creative.
Working knowledge of other platforms such as Google, Apple Ads, Snapchat etc.
Understanding of attribution and MMP mechanics: how platforms like Adjust or AppsFlyer measure installs, events, and in-app revenue, and where discrepancies come from.

AI-First Way of Working

You are expected to use AI tools actively in your day-to-day: for reporting, analysis, brief writing, and workflow automation.
The goal is to reduce manual overhead, not just stay busy. If you are doing something repetitive that a well-prompted tool can do, you should already be automating it.
Comfort with prompt engineering and integrating AI outputs into real workflows is a strong plus.

Analytical Rigour

You can pull data, build a view, and explain what it means without being hand-held.
You understand incrementality vs. last-touch attribution, and you can have an informed conversation about channel contribution.
You know what CAC, LTV, ROAS, and CPM mean in practice, not just as definitions.

Speed and Ownership

You do not wait to be told what is wrong. You monitor, spot it, and fix it or flag it.
You manage your own workload across campaigns and strategic tasks without dropping either.
Fast-paced environment is not a cliche here. It is the actual pace of this team.

Qualifications

3 to 5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with at least 2 years focused on paid social.
Experience managing and allocating performance marketing budgets across channels and markets with the ability to optimize spend based business objectives.
Proven track record running Meta and TikTok campaigns, not just setting them up.
Experience working with MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer, or equivalent) and understanding attribution at a platform level.
Exposure to q-commerce, food delivery, or e-commerce is a strong plus.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Experience running campaigns across both brand and performance objectives simultaneously.
Experience briefing creative teams and giving structured feedback on short-form video assets.
Hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing context (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar).

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Creative Strategist/ Art Director

Overview

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward-thinking, on-brand content solutions and campaigns that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.

As a Sr Creative Art based in Milan, you will shape the creative thinking and designs behind our work for the Italian market - turning client business challenges into sharp strategic platforms and bringing them creatively to life as ideas that can be seen, not just read. You will relish a fast-paced environment, juggle multiple deliverables, and be equally comfortable defending a strategic rationale and sketching out how the idea should look and feel.

The Role

Translate client briefs and market insight into compelling creative strategies and campaign platforms for the Italian market, with occasional work across wider Europe
Develop holistic, memorable campaigns from initial concept through to execution - Working closely with Creative Desk Project Managers, Art Directors and Copywriters to ensure end-to-end development and delivery of campaigns for assigned customers.
Maintain quality, accuracy and consistency of content and design across all mediums to best industry practice standards and client branding guidelines by ensuring all output is checked and errors minimised.
Overall responsibility for the production of communications material on time and to budget.
Bring strong conceptual skills and a highly developed ability to express those concepts across a continuously evolving set of channels
Craft short and long form copy in Italian and English for marketing purposes, including direct response designed to drive action and conversion
Think visually: shape look, feel, layout and tone alongside designers and art directors, and communicate ideas through sketches, mood boards, storyboards or scrappy mock-ups where words alone won't land
Execute across a wide array of channels including TV, online video, online banners, social platforms, and print - always to the highest standards of craft
Present work concisely in internal reviews and client meetings, in both Italian and English
Be proactive in bringing ideas that solve client challenges and grow the business

All About You

Native or fully fluent Italian, with proven experience building creative work for the Italian market and a genuine feel for its culture, media landscape and consumer behaviour
Fluent business English - you will work daily with colleagues and clients across Europe
Experience developing creative strategy and concepts within a creative agency environment or client-side marketing team
Ability to concept new campaigns across a variety of mediums, digital-first
Ability to combine conceptual creative thinking with high-quality delivery
A strong visual instinct - you have a point of view on design, typography and imagery
Ability to interpret brand and style guidelines from various clients and apply them consistently across marketing collateral
Ability to interpret creative briefing documents and translate them into compelling, on-strategy work
Captivating presentation skills
Passionate about social platforms, trends, technology and best practices
Excellent organizational and communication skills

A Plus

International or multi-market campaign experience
Experience in financial institutions, banking, payments or wider FI industries
Creative agency background
A solid understanding of the customer journey as it relates to card and banking (acquisition, conversion, activation, early month on books, customer loyalty, cross-sell)
A portfolio that shows both the thinking and the making - strategy decks alongside work you helped shape visually

Gross annual salary base range: 45,000 - 72,000 EUR

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:
Über uns

Mutabor
ist die größte unabhängige internationale Markenagentur, die in Deutschland gegründet wurde. Die Inhaber, Johannes Plass und Heinrich Paravicini, sind bis heute Teil der 6-köpfigen Geschäftsführung.

200 + Creative Consultants in Hamburg, Berlin und Los Angeles schaffen wirkungsvolle Lösungen, die auf ganzheitlichen Strategien, großartigem Design und modernster Technologie basieren.

Unter dem Leitmotiv »Brand Intelligence® unterstützt Mutabor Marken dabei, nicht nur relevant, sondern resilient und zukunftsfähig zu werden. Die Dienstleistungen umfassen u.a.: strategische Beratung, Gestaltung und adaptive Designsysteme inklusive Packaging, Live- und Digital Experience, Kommunikation sowie Brand Management.
Zu den Kund:innen gehören u.a. BMW-Motorrad, BRENNTAG, Clariant, GEA, die DFL, Henkel, HelleniQ Energy, Kleinanzeigen, Migros, OTTO, Pfizer, Porsche, Veltins und Volkswagen.

Mutabor ist der lateinische Ausdruck für den Willen zur Veränderung (ich werde verwandelt werden – i'm going to change). Dieser Wille treibt Mutabor seit der Gründung 1998 an. Mit über 700 Awards, unzähligen Projekten für Kund:innen fast aller Branchen – von Start-ups bis zu internationalen Konzernen – gehört Mutabor heute zu den größten unabhängigen Agenturen der Kreativbranche in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Creative Strategist (f/m/d) bei Mutabor Advertising bist du die strategische Instanz im Team: Du entwickelst eigenverantwortlich Kampagnenstrategien und Markenpositionierungen, gibst der Kreation die richtigen Sprungbretter und bringst Kund:innen auf Entscheider:innen-Ebene klare strategische Orientierung. Du übernimmst Projekte von Anfang bis Ende - von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Präsentation. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kreation und Beratung zusammen und wirkst punktuell auch bereichsübergreifend mit Expert:innen aus Brand Design, UX/UI Design, Motion Design und Architektur.
Du verantwortest und entwickelst eigenständig Kampagnenstrategien, Markenpositionierungen und zielgruppenspezifische Kommunikationsframeworks - von der Analyse bis zur Präsentation.
Du führst tiefgehende Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch und leitest daraus klare, überzeugende strategische Empfehlungen ab.
Du übersetzt Daten, Recherchen und kulturelle Beobachtungen in umsetzbare Strategien und kreative Leitideen, die der Kreation echten Auftrieb geben.
Du planst und moderierst Kund:innenworkshops und -präsentationen und führst diese souverän durch.
Du bringst dich aktiv in New-Business-Initiativen ein - von der Konzeption bis zur Präsentation.
Du behältst den Überblick über strategische Projektprozesse, sorgst für Transparenz gegenüber allen Stakeholder:innen und steuerst (Teil-)Projekte eigenverantwortlich.
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsmethoden, Tools und Prozessen im Strategiebereich voran und gibst dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen in deinem Team weiter.

Deine Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Kommunikationswissenschaft, Marketing, BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kommunikations- oder Markenstrategie-Agentur mit.
Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Führung von Strategie-Projekten und im direkten Kund:innenkontakt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, formulierst komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich und erstellst überzeugende Präsentationen, die Wirkung entfalten.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office – insbesondere PowerPoint – sowie Erfahrung mit strategischen Research-Tools wie Statista oder best4planning.
Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, bringst proaktiv Impulse ein und gibst strategische Impulse sowohl nach innen als auch nach außen.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für (unterhaltsame) Werbung, kulturelle Trends und kommunikationswirksame Ideen.

Wir bieten

Sei Teil der kreativsten Designagentur Deutschlands.
Hier findest du den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team. Von Corporate Design, UX-UI-Design über Architektur bis hin zu Motion Design - für jeden Kopf finden wir den richtigen Hut.
Unser Office in Hamburg bietet nicht nur ein eigenes Café, Dachterrasse mit Grill und Blick über den Hafen, sondern auch einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit neuester Technik.
Es finden regelmäßig Inhouse-Veranstaltungen zu Fortbildung und Teambuilding statt. Jeden Freitag lassen wir gemeinsam die Woche bei einem Drink ausklingen.
Du willst deine Sprachkenntnisse verbessern? Kein Problem, nimm Teil an unseren kostenlosen Deutsch- und Englischkursen.
Neben den 30 Tagen Urlaub, bekommst du zusätzlich an deinem Geburtstag einen Tag als Geschenk oben drauf.
Es gibt Möglichkeiten der Entgeltoptimierung (Deutschlandticket, Jobrad) und Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
Kontinuierliche und individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote sowie Entwicklungsgespräche.

By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our core values guide our approach to building and refining an internal product ecosystem that powers profitable acquisition models, flexible scaling, and optimized operations. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role Overview

Our Design department is scaling its AI visual production capabilities - and we're looking for a Senior AI Creative Designer
who will produce high-quality visual creatives
with the primary goal of improving conversion rates
. We’re looking for a designer who is deeply engaged with the fast-moving AI landscape, proactively tests new tools, features, and approaches, and is driven to continuously improve how AI is used in day-to-day creative work.This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, generative AI, and performance marketing - creating visual assets that capture attention and convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, and landing pages: from static ads to lifestyle imagery and photorealistic human characters.

You will work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to produce assets that are photorealistic, visually compelling, and true to client product specifications.

Responsibilities

AI Visual Production:

Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for performance marketing campaigns across paid media channels and landing pages.
Produce photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
Work with source materials from photo shoots - enhance, retouch, and extend imagery using AI tools.
Generate multiple creative variations to support testing and scaling across campaigns.
Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and product requirements across all assets.

Creative Iteration & Testing:

Iterate on visual concepts based on performance data and creative feedback.
Explore different visual angles, hooks, and formats to improve conversion rates.
Collaborate with copywriters and marketers to align visuals with messaging and funnel logic.
Translate briefs into multiple creative directions, not just single outputs.

Quality & Realism:

Ensure high visual quality and realism (lighting, composition, anatomy, textures).
Identify and fix common AI issues (artifacts, distortions, inconsistencies).
Maintain a strong visual standard across all generated content.

AI Tools & Workflow:

Use modern AI tools and models to generate, refine, and enhance visual assets.
Actively research, test, and integrate new AI tools to improve output quality.
Work within structured production workflows with a focus on execution and creative output.

Performance & Optimization:

Understand how visual content impacts campaign performance and audience engagement.
Adjust creative output based on data and testing results.
Support A/B testing by delivering multiple creative variants.

Collaboration:

Work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to ensure creative alignment.
Provide visual input during concept development and campaign planning.
Ensure assets are structured and ready for use in video production and marketing funnels.
Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards.

Requirements:

Skills & Background:

3-5+ years of experience in design, visual content creation, or creative digital marketing (paid social, social media content, performance campaigns)
1-2+ year of active hands-on experience with AI image generation platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar) - producing photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
Cross-platform proficiency, experience in connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).
Strong visual sense: composition, lighting, color, typography, realism, and human anatomy.
AI-Geek: stays close to AI news and new releases, experiments hands-on with emerging features and workflows, and is constantly looking for smarter ways to improve the quality, speed, and effectiveness of creative work.
Ability to conduct audience/target group research and reflect it properly in the visuals
Understanding of performance marketing basics (CTR, hooks, conversion-focused creative).
Ability to iterate quickly based on feedback and data.
Strong attention to detail and visual quality.
Proactive mindset - suggesting improvements, not just executing tasks.
Clear communication and strong collaboration skills.
Portfolio with AI-generated photorealistic visuals demonstrating quality and high-end visual sensibility.
Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher.

Nice to Have:

Basic understanding of how static visuals translate into video production pipelines.
Experience producing creative assets for high-CPA verticals (home services, insurance, finance, or similar).
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
